jobs.title: Développeur(euse) senior en automatisation QA
jobs.excerpt: À propos de nous nesto est une fintech canadienne fondée à Montréal en 2018.
jobs.description:
À propos de nous

nesto est une fintech canadienne fondée à Montréal en 2018. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin. Nous avons débuté comme courtier numérique misant sur la technologie pour apporter de la transparence au processus hypothécaire, puis nous avons bâti la principale plateforme canadienne de prêt hypothécaire en ligne directe aux consommateurs, où des experts hypothécaires qualifiés sont appuyés par une technologie de pointe.

Depuis, nous sommes devenus un écosystème hypothécaire complet, au service de grandes institutions financières partout au Canada à titre de partenaire B2B. Notre premier produit B2B a été lancé en 2022 avec IG Gestion de patrimoine. En 2024, nesto a fait l'acquisition du Groupe CMLS, formant ainsi le Groupe Nesto (nesto, CMLS et sa marque filiale Intellifi). Nous comptons aujourd'hui 1 300 employés répartis dans 12 bureaux à l'échelle du pays et 73 milliards de dollars canadiens d'actifs hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration.

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Notre croissance entraîne la création de nouvelles équipes de développement, et chaque équipe compte un(e) Développeur(euse) senior en automatisation QA (I ou II) au cœur de sa structure. Nous souhaitons aussi continuer à améliorer nos pratiques d'assurance qualité; nous avons donc besoin d'une personne capable de renforcer l'automatisation, de rehausser les normes de qualité et de façonner la manière dont nos équipes conçoivent et livrent leurs logiciels. Ce poste relève du chef ou de la cheffe d'équipe en ingénierie. Votre pile technologique quotidienne comprendra Playwright, Postman, Datadog, Docker, ArgoCD, GitHub, TypeScript et MySQL. Comme indiqué dans la section « Ce que vous apportez », nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous les maîtrisiez tous.

Lieu de travail et disponibilité

Ce poste, en mode télétravail d'abord, est ouvert aux candidat(e)s partout au Canada. Travaillez de la maison ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux, notamment à Montréal, Toronto, Vancouver, Winnipeg, Ottawa et Calgary.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Concevoir, bâtir et maintenir des suites de tests automatisés robustes et évolutives avec Playwright, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques et les patrons de conception de l'industrie afin d'assurer leur maintenabilité à long terme.
  • Collaborer avec les développeurs et les gestionnaires de produit tout au long du cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC) pour clarifier les exigences, repérer les lacunes tôt et définir les critères d'acceptation lors des cérémonies Agiles.
  • Piloter la qualité tant du côté des tests d'interface (UI) que des tests d'API, en tirant parti des signaux de surveillance, des revues d'incidents et de la rétroaction des clients pour cibler les occasions d'amélioration.
  • Exploiter l'IA de façon novatrice pour soutenir et accélérer les tâches de développement en automatisation de l'AQ.
  • Prendre en charge les résultats de qualité au sens large en demeurant impliqué(e) au-delà de l'exécution des tests, afin d'améliorer les processus, la documentation et les méthodes de travail de l'équipe.
  • Adopter un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue en restant à l'affût des nouveaux outils, technologies et méthodologies de test.
  • Collaborer avec les développeurs(-euses) staff en automatisation de l'AQ pour améliorer les processus et les pratiques d'assurance qualité à l'échelle de l'organisation.
  • Travailler avec les gestionnaires de produit pour définir des plans de tests complets à partir des documents de conception, comme les PRD et les HLD.
  • Soutenir les tests d'acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) pour les projets clés, par exemple lors de l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires ou clients.
  • Réviser et exécuter des cas et des scripts de tests manuels pour les fonctionnalités en développement à l'aide d'outils de gestion et de suivi des tests, afin de fournir à l'équipe de projet une rétroaction sur leur potentiel d'automatisation.
  • Valider manuellement les fonctionnalités selon les plans de tests et intégrer ces scénarios à la suite de tests de régression automatisés.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité sur des applications SaaS ou infonuagiques, avec une compréhension approfondie du cycle de développement logiciel complet et de la place de l'ingénierie de la qualité dans le processus de développement.
  • Plus de 2 ans d'expérience pratique avec un cadre d'automatisation comme Playwright, Cypress ou un outil similaire, avec une capacité démontrée à créer, maintenir et faire évoluer des suites de tests de bout en bout (E2E).
  • Un état d'esprit « automatisation d'abord », avec des antécédents démontrant la priorité accordée à la couverture automatisée plutôt qu'à l'AQ uniquement manuelle, et l'intégration de la fiabilité dans le pipeline CI/CD.
  • Une capacité de test pleine pile couvrant les couches UI et API, y compris de l'expérience avec des outils comme Postman pour la validation d'API, assurant une couverture complète à tous les niveaux de la pile.
  • Une expertise en architecture de tests et en conception évolutive, avec la capacité de bâtir des suites d'automatisation maintenables selon les patrons de conception standards de l'industrie (p. ex. Page Object Model, fabriques de données, séparation des responsabilités).
  • Une aisance avec la méthodologie Agile et ses outils, incluant le confort de travailler dans des environnements de livraison rapide avec des cycles de mise en production fréquents, et une familiarité avec des plateformes de gestion de tests comme Allure TestOps pour le suivi et les rapports.
  • Une solide expérience avec TypeScript et/ou Go est un atout, tout comme l'expérience avec MySQL ou une base de données relationnelle similaire.

Ce poste est peut-être pour vous si

  • Vous abordez l'automatisation avec un état d'esprit de génie logiciel, en appliquant la même rigueur, les mêmes patrons de conception et les mêmes normes d'évolutivité qu'un développeur applique à une fonctionnalité clé.
  • Vous êtes un(e) adepte du « Shift Left » (tests en amont) qui clarifie les exigences dès la planification, bien avant l'écriture de la première ligne de code.
  • Vous avez une vision globale de la qualité, fondée sur les données, qui va au-delà des tests d'interface de base pour exploiter les tests d'API, les signaux système et la rétroaction des clients afin de trouver des pistes d'amélioration.
  • Vous êtes tourné(e) vers l'IA et curieux(-euse) sur le plan technique, et vous expérimentez avec des outils modernes pour affiner votre stratégie et accroître votre impact.
  • Vous améliorez continuellement les façons de faire de l'équipe et prenez en charge les processus et la documentation sans qu'on vous le demande.

Vous ne devriez pas postuler si

  • Vous êtes principalement testeur(-euse) manuel(le) et ne souhaitez pas concevoir l'automatisation ni apprendre de nouvelles technologies.
  • Vous préférez une approche réactive de type « cascade », où vous attendez la fin du développement avant de vous impliquer.
  • Vous cherchez un rôle étroit et à portée fixe, où vous exécutez des tests plutôt que de remettre en question les exigences et de repérer les lacunes.
  • Vous préférez travailler en vase clos et ne souhaitez pas améliorer les méthodes de travail, la documentation ou les processus de qualité de l'équipe.
  • Vous n'êtes pas prêt(e) à intégrer les outils d'IA dans votre travail quotidien.

Processus d'entrevue

  • Entrevue avec le recruteur (30 minutes) : une première conversation sur votre parcours et le poste.
  • Exercice à faire à la maison : une étude de cas que l'équipe évalue pour déterminer votre niveau technique.
  • Entrevue technique (60 minutes) : une plongée technique avec deux de nos développeurs(-euses) staff en automatisation de l'AQ, incluant une discussion de votre étude de cas.
  • Entrevue finale (60 minutes) : une entrevue non technique avec l'équipe d'embauche.
  • Étape de l'offre : vérifications des antécédents, du casier judiciaire et des références, suivies d'une offre formelle.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Couverture santé complète : assurance maladie complémentaire, soins dentaires et soins de la vue de premier ordre, avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Compte de dépenses santé et mieux-être : un fonds flexible annuel combiné de 1 500 $ pour les abonnements au gym ou les besoins médicaux supplémentaires.
  • Congés payés généreux : 4 semaines de vacances, plus 8 journées personnelles flottantes.
  • Épargne-retraite : un régime collectif REER/RPDB avec des cotisations de contrepartie concurrentielles de l'employeur.
  • Télémédecine : accès via Dialogue et couverture des services de praticiens agréés.
  • Soutien à la famille : programmes de complément de salaire pour les congés de maternité et les congés parentaux.
  • Travail flexible : entièrement en télétravail ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux à Montréal, Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver et ailleurs.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

  • Hypercroissance : palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte, trois années consécutives.
  • Crédibilité dans la communauté techno : Canadian Rocketship 2025 de TechTO.
  • Leadership dans l'industrie : Lending Company of the Year de la CLA, quatre années consécutives.
  • Reconnaissance des talents : CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025.
  • Technologie de confiance : au service de grandes institutions financières partout au Canada.
  • Une culture fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, des normes élevées et un véritable souci des gens que nous servons.

Diversité et inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration naissent d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous nous engageons à bâtir un milieu de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes racisées, les personnes LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à poser leur candidature.

Veuillez noter qu'étant donné que nous servons des client(e)s situé(e)s dans tout le Canada, il est essentiel d'être bilingue pour ce poste. Vous pourriez être amené(e) à communiquer en français et en anglais.

The Scientific Director provides strategic scientific and publications oversight across multiple accounts. Leveraging strong scientific and creative expertise, they will guide and drive the strategic development of CiTRUS to provide scientific counsel both internally and to their clients and will provide support in identifying and converting new opportunities.

  • Lead all activities related to scientific strategies and publication planning, including oversight of scientifically complex materials
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on scientific and clinical aspects of client projects and deliverables
  • Support ongoing training of team members
  • Continuously offer strategic and innovative ideas to support in achieving client and team objectives
  • Support cross-functional teams to meet client needs
  • Review deliverables with a scientific lens to ensure quality standards and ensure client expectations are met
  • Ensure timely delivery of high-quality products and services to clients
  • Keep leadership informed of critical client and project updates and concerns
  • Keep abreast of the scientific developments relevant to accounts, disseminating information to the broader account team in a regular and timely manner, and to clients as appropriate

Client Management

  • Prepare strategic and tactical plans for each client and individual project plans as needed
  • Attend and lead aspects of regular client status meetings, new project kick-offs, and debrief meetings; communicate key learnings to client and internal team
  • Regularly review project reports and alert client and project teams of emerging trends and any shifting clinical data points
  • Expedite development of CiTRUS’ scientific reputation with each client
  • Ensure a high level of service, mutual respect and trust to create effective partnerships with clients, key experts, and other external partners
  • Liaise effectively with clients and key experts, acting as the primary point of contact according to account requirements

External Communications

Where appropriate and necessary, communicate with authors and/or clients concerning project status and changes

  • Actively participate in client presentations, communicating and promoting CiTRUS’ expertise and informed perspectives
  • Support project team in proactively anticipating, addressing, and responding to author/client requests
  • Support the development of New Business, working with the commercial team as appropriate to identify and convert new targets and opportunities
  • Provide scientific support in the development of proposals/pitches as appropriate

Education

Higher degree in the life sciences; PhD, MD or PharmD preferred

Experience

  • 6+ years of publications experience within the pharmaceutical or medical communications industry
  • Demonstrated understanding of product life cycles, competitive landscapes, and role of publications in client’s medical and commercial strategies
  • Experience translating complex data into effective presentation formats

Special Knowledge / Skills

  • Strong understanding of clinical research and analyses
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to identify key issues; creatively and strategically overcome challenges
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability
  • Ability to think analytically and to effectively plan, prioritize, and execute
  • Expert verbal and written communication skills
  • Expert presentation skills with a variety of formats to a variety of audiences
  • Ability to work to the allocated deadlines and specification
  • Understanding and application of good publications and practice and relevant compliance requirements
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite; especially Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to produce well-designed and effective decks

Position Overview:
The NQE Pricing Specialist is responsible for managing the pricing and rate-lock process for Non-QM mortgage loans, with a focus on exception pricing, off-sheet offerings, and risk-based pricing decisions. This role serves as a critical liaison between Sales, Credit, and Secondary Marketing to support pricing that is competitive, compliant, and aligned with CCM’s strategic objectives in a dynamic, exception-driven environment.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Report as a member of Non-QM rate lock desk, including issuing lock confirmations, tracking lock expirations, and maintaining compliance with lock policies.
  • Assess and price exception scenarios that fall outside standard rate sheets, working closely with Credit and Underwriting teams to evaluate compensating factors and layered risk.
  • Issue accurate and timely pricing quotes for Non-QM products, including base and exception-level pricing, off-sheet rates, and custom takeout pricing.
  • Analyze loan-level risk characteristics, including credit, assets, income, occupancy, and documentation; determine appropriate pricing overlays or exceptions based on investor appetite and internal guidelines. This includes evaluating non-QM terms such as prepayment penalties (PPP), debt service coverage ratio (DSCR), and alternative income documentation types.
  • Collaborate with the Secondary Marketing and Capital Markets teams to ensure that offered pricing aligns with hedge positions, investor guidelines, and market movements.
  • Monitor pipeline health and manage pricing exceptions throughout the loan lifecycle, identifying and resolving pricing discrepancies pre- and post-closing.
  • Keep abreast of market conditions, LLPA updates, investor guideline changes, and Non-QM trends that may have an impact on pricing or lock policy.
  • Document pricing exceptions and justifications thoroughly in the loan origination system and CRM, ensuring transparency and audit readiness.
  • Provide insights and reporting to management on exception trends, investor hit rates, lock fallout, and margin impact.
  • Ensure all rate lock and pricing actions adhere to compliance standards, investor requirements, and internal controls, especially within the context of the non-QM market.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience in mortgage banking.
  • 3+ years of experience in Non-QM pricing or rate lock desk operations, with direct responsibility for exception pricing decisions.
  • Advanced experience with Non-QM guidelines, investor overlays, and borrower risk evaluation criteria.
  • Excellent analytical, quantitative, and decision-making skills.
  • Advanced collaboration and communication skills to interact effectively with Sales, Credit, Capital Markets, and external partners.
  • Excellent organizational, task-management, and attention-to-detail skills applied consistently to achieve objectives.
  • Experience with pricing engines such as Optimal Blue and LoanSifter.
  • Experience with Encompass loan origination system.

Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

The Liability Claims Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of claims professionals handling liability and casualty claims, including Bodily Injury (BI), Commercial General Liability (CGL), transportation liability, and other property and casualty exposures. This role ensures claims are handled in accordance with company standards, client expectations, and regulatory requirements while maintaining a high level of service and operational performance.
The role provides technical guidance, coaching, and leadership to claims staff while supporting effective claim resolution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development
  • Supervise and support a team of liability claims adjusters.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to adjusters handling bodily injury, casualty, and liability claims.
  • Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions, and ongoing training to support staff development.
  • Assist with staffing, onboarding, and workload distribution across the team.
Claims Oversight
  • Monitor claims handling activities to ensure compliance with company guidelines and client service standards.
  • Review high-exposure or complex liability claims and provide guidance on claim strategy and resolution.
  • Approve claim settlements within assigned authority levels.
  • Ensure appropriate reserve setting and claim documentation.
Client & Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Serve as a point of contact for clients regarding claim performance and operational questions.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide updates regarding claim trends, outcomes, and performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with legal counsel, vendors, and internal teams to support effective claim resolution.
Operational Performance
  • Monitor team performance metrics including claim cycle time, quality assurance results, and service level agreements.
  • Identify opportunities for operational improvements and implement best practices.
  • Support leadership with reporting and operational updates.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

  • 5+ years of claims handling experience in liability, casualty, or bodily injury claims.
  • Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of liability claims handling practices and litigation management.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

Benefits
At Davies North America, we are dedicated to supporting the well‑being and future of our qualifying employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and that of your family

  • Life insurance and short‑term and long‑term disability coverage
Benefit offerings, eligibility, and required employer contributions may vary based on role, classification, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those tied to an employee’s primary work location.
Where required by law, the Company provides paid sick leave, paid family and parental leave, and other mandated benefits in accordance with applicable state and local requirements.
Diversity and Inclusion
Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

Compensation Transparency:
The salary range listed reflects the full compensation band for this role across all locations. jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We're looking for a Google PPC Specialist who lives and breathes paid search, someone who blends data-driven rigor with strategic thinking to build high-performing lead generation and revenue-driving campaigns on Google. You'll own campaigns end-to-end across both services and ecommerce verticals, pushing performance beyond benchmarks while constantly testing and optimizing what's next. If you've thrived inside an agency managing multiple accounts simultaneously and know the Google Ads ecosystem inside-out, we want to talk.

  1. Plan, build, and manage full-funnel Google Ads campaigns from strategy through execution, including campaign structure, keyword research, targeting, ad copy, bidding, and budget allocation.

  2. Manage Google Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and other relevant Google Ads campaign types.

  3. Analyze CPL, ROAS, CAC, conversion rates, search impression share, CTR, CPC, and attribution data to identify inefficiencies and growth opportunities.

  4. Conduct structured A/B tests across keywords, ad copy, landing pages, audiences, offers, bidding strategies, and campaign structures, turning results into actionable learnings.

  5. Develop compelling search ad copy, messaging angles, and keyword strategies aligned with customer intent and business goals.

  6. Optimize campaigns for qualified lead volume across service-based and ecommerce verticals, integrating lead quality feedback from CRM and sales teams.

  7. Manage and allocate significant ad budgets efficiently, scaling profitable campaigns while maintaining target CPL, CPA, and ROAS goals.

  8. Conduct ongoing keyword research, search term analysis, negative keyword management, competitor research, and account cleanup to maximize campaign efficiency.

  9. Ensure robust conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager setup, GA4 integration, enhanced conversions, offline conversion tracking, and attribution accuracy in coordination with development and analytics teams.

  10. Monitor and optimize landing page performance and collaborate with CRO teams to improve conversion rates and lead quality.

  11. Translate campaign performance into clear, compelling reports for clients or internal stakeholders, highlighting performance trends, insights, and recommended actions.


Requirements

​​

QUALIFICATIONS

  1. 4+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns, preferably in a digital marketing or performance agency.

  2. Proven track record running lead generation campaigns for US-based businesses.

  3. Strong experience managing Google Ads for US home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, landscaping, pest control, remodeling, etc.).

  4. Experience running campaigns for both US home service and US ecommerce brands is a plus.

  5. Must be able to share Google Ads campaign results, ad examples, or relevant case studies from US home service campaigns you've worked on.

  6. Advanced knowledge of Google Ads, Google Ads Editor, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and Google Merchant Center.

  7. Strong understanding of keyword research, match types, negative keywords, Quality Score, audience targeting, remarketing, bidding strategies, conversion tracking, and attribution.

  8. Advanced experience with Search, Performance Max, Shopping, Display, and YouTube campaigns.

  9. Strong understanding of lead generation funnels, conversion tracking, offline conversion imports, enhanced conversions, and CRM integrations.

  10. Experience with Google Lead Form Ads and CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

  11. Strong understanding of GA4 and landing page CRO best practices.

  12. Google Ads Certification is required.

  13. Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, and performance forecasting.

  14. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  15. Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, or Microsoft Ads is an advantage.


Benefits

WORK SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION

  1. Full-time remote position.

  2. Must be comfortable working Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours.

  3. Starting rate: USD $4.00 per hour.

  4. Must have a reliable computer/laptop, stable high-speed internet connection, noise-free workspace, and backup internet/power solution to ensure uninterrupted productivity.

REQUIRED FOR APPLICATION

  1. An updated resume with shareable links to Google Ads campaign examples, case studies, or relevant work samples included in the resume.

  2. A brief summary of your experience managing Google Ads for US home service businesses.

  3. 2–5 examples of Google Ads campaigns, ad copy, landing pages, dashboards, or case studies from US home service businesses (e.g., HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, landscaping, pest control, remodeling, etc.) that you have personally worked on.

  5. Include the shareable links in your resume for easy review.

Position Description
As the Director of Sales, you will be responsible for driving new logo acquisition and revenue growth across health plans, employers, TPAs, consultants, and health systems.

This is a true hunter role focused on identifying, developing, and closing strategic enterprise opportunities within a complex healthcare landscape.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven track record of exceeding sales quotas through proactive prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined execution of complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.

This individual must be comfortable getting into the details of sophisticated healthcare benefit and virtual care solutions, working closely with internal business partners and external stakeholders to design solutions that meet client needs.

This position owns the entire customer acquisition lifecycle, from prospecting and opportunity development through contracting, implementation support, and formal transition to Client Success. Success requires close collaboration with Product, Clinical, Network, Operations, Finance, Legal, Implementation, Marketing, and Client Success teams to develop customized solutions and navigate complex organizational structures.

The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, learns quickly, maintains a positive and team-oriented mindset, and has the persistence and resilience necessary to win highly competitive enterprise opportunities.

Essential Job Functions

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition within an assigned territory through strategic prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined pipeline management to meet or exceed annual revenue quotas.
  • Develop and execute territory and account strategies, buyer engagement plans, and opportunity-specific sales motions that create a clear path to close.
  • Lead complex, consultative sales processes involving clinical, operational, financial, technology, procurement, legal, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of prospect benefit strategies, plan designs, funding arrangements, member engagement challenges, and total cost of care objectives to position MDLIVE solutions effectively.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with health plans, employers, consultants, TPAs, health systems, brokers, and strategic partners.
  • Partner closely with Product, Clinical, Network, Operations, Finance, Legal, Implementation, Marketing, and Client Success teams to develop customized solutions and ensure successful execution throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Coordinate and lead internal deal teams, driving alignment, accountability, and timely execution from opportunity development through contracting, implementation readiness, and transition to Client Success.
  • Navigate complex organizational structures, procurement processes, stakeholder dynamics, and decision-making frameworks to advance opportunities and remove barriers to close.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, forecasting, and opportunity management within Salesforce while providing visibility into deal progress, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Develop pricing strategies, financial proposals, and business cases that align customer needs with MDLIVE's growth objectives.
  • Monitor competitive activity, market trends, virtual care innovations, and healthcare benefit developments to refine positioning and strengthen sales strategies.
  • Provide market feedback and customer insights to influence product development, pricing strategies, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Manage and develop assigned direct reports, including coaching, performance management, and professional development.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Demonstrated success meeting and exceeding enterprise sales quotas in healthcare, digital health, benefits, or virtual care markets.
  • Proven track record of acquiring net-new logos and building pipeline through proactive business development efforts.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare benefits, plan design, funding arrangements, and employer and health plan buying processes.
  • Strong knowledge of the virtual care, digital health, and healthcare benefits ecosystem.
  • Ability to manage complex, detail-oriented sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and extended purchasing timelines.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop customized client solutions and navigate operational, clinical, technical, and contractual requirements.
  • Established executive-level relationships within health plans, employers, consultants, TPAs, and healthcare organizations.
  • Strong executive presence with demonstrated success engaging C-suite decision makers.
  • Exceptional organizational, analytical, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to rapidly learn new products, market dynamics, and healthcare trends.
  • Positive, collaborative, team-first mindset with a strong work ethic and high degree of accountability.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience utilizing Salesforce and related sales technologies to maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline visibility.
  • Experience in utilizing AI tools on a day-to-day basis to support workflows and to create efficiencies.
  • Ability to work effectively across complex organizations and influence outcomes without direct authority.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of enterprise healthcare sales experience, preferably within virtual care, digital health, health plans, healthcare benefits, or employer solutions.
  • Demonstrated success selling to health plans, large employers, consultants, TPAs, and healthcare organizations.
  • Proven history of achieving or exceeding annual sales quotas and revenue targets.
  • Experience selling solutions that require coordination across clinical, operational, financial, technology, and executive stakeholder groups.
  • Experience with provider network strategy or network contracting is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing opportunities through implementation and client transition processes preferred.

Travel Requirements

Up to 40%


If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

About Evernorth Health Services

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email for assistance. Please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.

The Cigna Group has a tobacco-free policy and reserves the right not to hire tobacco/nicotine users in states where that is legally permissible. Candidates in such states who use tobacco/nicotine will not be considered for employment unless they enter a qualifying smoking cessation program prior to the start of their employment. These states include: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, and Washington State.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

jobs.excerpt: ITX is Hiring a Senior Software Engineer with Agentic AI Expertise!
jobs.description:
ITX is Hiring a Senior Software Engineer with Agentic AI Expertise!

We're looking for an Engineer with deep expertise in AI Agent development to design and implement scalable, autonomous AI systems that power exceptional user experiences.

In this role, you'll focus on building on top of agentic platforms and conversational AI systems, enabling intelligent, multi-step reasoning and seamless tool integration across systems. You'll work in a multi-cloud environment, leveraging Azure and GCP to deliver dynamic AI solutions that adapt to evolving client needs.

Note: This role is limited to candidates based in LATAM. Candidates from other locations will not be considered for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
  • Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, integrating vector databases (Azure AI Search, Snowflake, Pinecone, PostgreSQL) with LLMs for grounded, accurate responses.
  • Develop tool-use and function-calling architectures that let agents interact reliably with APIs, internal systems, and external services.
  • Maintain and extend the data pipelines that feed agentic workflows (e.g. ingestion, transformation, and vector-store updates), ensuring agents have access to accurate, up-to-date context.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and ML engineers to operationalize and fine-tune LLMs, and integrate cloud AI services (Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI) into agentic workflows.
  • Implement evaluation, observability, and guardrail practices for LLM-based systems, ensuring reliability, safety, and consistent behavior in production.
  • Design authentication and authorization handling for multi-agent systems — ensuring user identity, permissions, and access scope propagate correctly as a request moves from the orchestration layer to the specialized agents and services handling it.
  • Design conversational and agentic experiences (chatbots, copilots, task-automation agents) that scale across multiple channels and use cases.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and LLM providers to deliver best-in-class performance and cost efficiency.

What We're Looking For

  • Agentic AI Expertise: Hands-on experience building with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or comparable agent orchestration frameworks.
  • RAG & Retrieval: Strong understanding of vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies for grounding LLM outputs.
  • LLM Integration: Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models) and cloud AI services (Azure AI, GCP Vertex AI) for deploying agents at scale.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in Python, with experience designing APIs and integrating agents with existing systems and data sources.
  • Data Engineering (Preferred): Fundamentals or demonstrable proficiency with data pipelines and cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), enough to maintain and troubleshoot the data flows that support agentic and RAG systems. This is not a data engineering role — it's an AI role, and data engineering skills are desirable rather than required.
  • Identity & Access Management: Experience with identity and access management in distributed or service-oriented systems — token-based authentication, propagating authorization across service boundaries, and scoping what data or actions a given user is allowed to reach — applied in an agentic or multi-agent context.
  • Governance & Safety: Understanding of LLM evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
  • Soft Skills: Analytical mindset, excellent communication, and ability to explain technical concepts to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Pace & Ways of Working: We run modern Agile — Kanban — and the pace is fast and intense. We're looking for people who thrive in that environment and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.
  • English bilingual proficiency.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex certifications
  • And/or demonstrableproficiency in agentic development — production-grade code, shipped agentic systems, or an equivalent hands-on portfolio. Certifications are a plus, not a screening requirement.

ITX’s Compensation Philosophy

Equality in compensation has been our practice since ITX started in 1997.

ITX believes that market-based pay ensures fair and equitable compensation for our worldwide team members and pay that is based on the market, not on who has the best negotiation skills. At ITX, you’ll never discover that someone in the same job with the same experience makes more than you, or that there are pay gaps based on race, gender, disability, or age.

How do our team members experience market-based pay at ITX? We gather market data to benchmark each position in our candidates’ and team members’ locations and use these benchmarks for candidate offers and to perform regular compensation reviews for our team members. You’ll never have to worry about asking for a pay raise again. At least once a year ITX automatically adjusts pay when the benchmark is higher than our team member’s compensation.

In LATAM the pay range for theSenior Software Engineer (Agentic AI Development)role is $5,400 to $7,900 monthly, depending on experience, specific skills and certifications, and education. Based on your location in LATAM pay ranges could be adjusted according to local market data, which can vary from country to country. This variation percentage could be 16% lower or 14% higher.

Do you have questions about ITX’s compensation practices? Let us know! We’re proud of how we do compensation at ITX and welcome the opportunity to share more.

This role was posted by ITX on August 7, 2026.

Salary: USD $5,400 to $7,900

About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.
We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.
The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Director of Coalition Alignment & Governance Strategy is a senior leadership position responsible for ensuring strategic alignment across California Working Families Party's governance structures, regional leadership bodies, staff teams, and elected champions. This role serves as the primary bridge between the State Steering Committee, Regional Committees, elected officials, organizational partners, and staff leadership to ensure that CA WFP operates as a cohesive statewide political organization.

The Director will lead the development and implementation of California WFP's co-governance strategy, helping elected officials and movement leaders govern together around shared priorities while strengthening the party's long-term political infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be an experienced coalition builder, political strategist, facilitator, and manager who can navigate complex relationships, build alignment across diverse stakeholders, and drive execution on statewide priorities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    Party Governance and Regional Alignment

  • Collaborate closely with the State Director, CA WFP Officers, and State Steering Committee to develop and implement statewide political, organizational, and governing strategies.

  • Serve as the primary staff lead for the California State Steering Committee, including agenda development, meeting facilitation, follow-up, implementation tracking, and leadership development.

  • Manage regional steering committees as assigned by the State Director

  • Staff the work of the CA WFP Officers and provide strategic support related to governance, party growth, regional alignment, and organizational development.

  • Ensure strong alignment between statewide priorities and Regional Committee strategies, programs, and decision-making processes.

  • Build systems that improve communication, coordination, accountability, and collaboration between regional and statewide leadership bodies.

  • Support the ongoing development of democratic governance structures that strengthen participation, accountability, and strategic decision-making across the organization.

  • Manage the annual dues collections from coalition members.

  • Coordinate communication, workflow, and strategic alignment between State Steering Committee members, Regional Committees, staff, and organizational partners.

    • Governance and Elected Leadership Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of California WFP's statewide co-governance strategy.

  • Plan and execute annual statewide governance and co-governance convenings.

  • Support the planning and facilitation of regional governance and co-governance gatherings throughout the state.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with elected officials, candidates, labor leaders, movement organizations, and coalition partners.

  • Coordinate regular engagement opportunities for elected officials, including statewide elected official meetings, issue-based governing discussions, and strategic planning sessions.

  • Develop and facilitate a monthly statewide elected officials call focused on policy priorities, governing opportunities, movement alignment, and shared strategy.

  • Coordinate issue-based co-governance campaigns that connect elected officials, movement organizations, and party leaders around common priorities.

  • Work closely with regional leadership and elected champions to establish regional co-governance tables and governing structures.

  • Support elected officials in building stronger relationships with movement organizations and community leaders throughout California.

    • Staff Management and Organizational Leadership

  • Supervise staff as assigned by the State Director.

  • Support cross-department coordination to ensure organizing, electoral, governance, communications, and development work are aligned with statewide priorities.

  • Participate as a senior leader in organizational planning, staff development, and strategic decision-making.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and political alignment across staff teams.

    • Political Strategy and Coalition Building

  • Maintain strong relationships with labor unions, community organizations, member leaders, donors, elected officials, and movement allies.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen California WFP's political infrastructure, coalition relationships, and governing power throughout the state.

  • Represent California WFP in coalition spaces, governance tables, and strategic political discussions as assigned by the State Director.

  • Support the development of long-term political strategies that connect electoral success to governing power and durable movement-building.

  • Work across departments and stakeholder groups to ensure California WFP functions as an integrated statewide political organization.

  • Lead special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the State Director.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Organizational Leadership: At least 8 years of experience serving as an advisor, strategist, or senior leader within political, labor, advocacy, or democratic organizations. Proven ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders and translate strategy into action.

  • Governance and Coalition Management: Deep experience managing coalitions, steering committees, boards, elected leaders, or other governing bodies. Strong understanding of relationship building, consensus development, and organizational decision-making.

  • Exceptional People Leadership: Proven experience managing staff; setting expectations; developing talent; leading performance management; and building strong, trust-based relationships across lines of difference.

  • Co-Governance and Political Strategy: Experience working with elected officials, candidates, labor unions, and community organizations to advance shared governing, policy, or political priorities. Knowledge of California's political and movement ecosystem preferred.

  • Superior Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to facilitate complex conversations, navigate competing interests, and translate political and organizational priorities into clear guidance, decisions, and systems that support alignment and execution.

Role Title: Retail CX Policy Expert

In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

You will author authentic return, refund, and eligibility policies modeled after real-world US retail and e-commerce operations, creating the authoritative standards by which AI agents are evaluated. This opportunity involves comprehensive policy creation and scenario design, ensuring the coverage of nuanced, edge-case situations encountered in modern CX environments.

Scope of Work

  1. Author and document detailed return, refund, and eligibility policies reflecting up-to-date US retail and e-commerce practices.
  2. Design nuanced customer-service scenarios, including edge cases, to surface policy ambiguities and operational gaps.
  3. Establish clear, correct customer-service resolutions for both standard and exceptional situations according to your authored policies.
  4. Create precise grading rubrics for evaluating agent performance on complex, multi-step customer experience cases.
  5. Identify, document, and escalate policy conflicts or ambiguities to ensure comprehensive AI environment coverage.
  6. Collaborate with domain leads and quality calibration contributors to evolve policies as project requirements shift.
  7. Define and validate “golden outcomes” for AI model training and assessment.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in US retail or e-commerce CX operations, including escalation handling and process design.
  2. Direct background in authoring or redesigning return, refund, and eligibility policies (not just executing prewritten guidelines).
  3. Deep knowledge of US retail conventions: return windows, restocking fees, gift returns, damaged goods, chargeback handling, and marketplace fulfillment.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on unambiguous policy documentation.
  5. Bachelor’s degree preferred (business, operations, or related disciplines) or equivalent real-world expertise.

jobs.excerpt: What We’re BuildingHoneycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do!
jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The Field Reliability Engineer (FRE) is an extension of Honeycomb’s extensive brand and technical expertise focused on our customer base via engagements, support and our managed services. In this role you parachute into the most complex, highest-stakes technical situations our customers face - unblocking them when they’re stuck, creating tooling, guiding our Solution Architecture team through complex decisions, and ensuring prospects and customers get the most out of Honeycomb and the broader observability ecosystem.

You’re equal parts platform engineer and customer engineer. You build and operate the managed infrastructure our largest customers depend on, and you’re the technical backstop the SA team calls when a deal gets deep into infrastructure, data pipelines, or production debugging. This isn’t a support role - it’s a technical leadership role where you solve problems that don’t have runbooks yet, build the platforms and tooling so the next person can have a runbook, and directly impact revenue by unblocking our most strategic deals.

What You’ll Do

Platform Engineering — Architecture & Standards Ownership

  • Define the architecture and operational standards for Refinery as a Service (RaaS) and Honeycomb Private Cloud (HnyPC) — decisions other engineers build within — across multiple AWS accounts and regions.
  • Architect the Terraform modules, Helm charts, and deployment automation that other FREs build on and extend, not just consume.
  • Set the technical direction for how Honeycomb instruments, monitors, and operates its own managed infrastructure — using Honeycomb to monitor Honeycomb.
  • Own capacity planning, scaling strategy, upgrade sequencing, and cost optimization across multi-region AWS environments.
  • Build platforms and automation that change how the FRE team operates at scale — enabling the team to grow without proportional headcount.

Technical Escalation & Unblocking

  • Serve as the final technical escalation point for the most novel, highest-stakes customer situations — problems with no precedent in existing runbooks.
  • Resolve deep infrastructure and observability issues spanning distributed systems, Kubernetes clusters, AWS networking (ALBs, PrivateLink, NLBs, VPCs), and polyglot service meshes, often in real time under revenue-critical pressure.
  • Partner directly with customer SRE, platform, and engineering leadership to navigate multi-week escalations and architecture redesigns tied to the company's largest relationships.
  • Provide senior incident command for managed services (RaaS, HnyPC) — the point of last escalation when Tier 2 support and IC3/IC4 engineers need staff-level judgment.
  • Build the playbooks, diagnostic frameworks, and tooling that let IC3/IC4 engineers operate independently in situations that previously required staff involvement.

Open Source & Ecosystem Leadership

  • Shape Honeycomb's open source strategy in the OpenTelemetry ecosystem — drive initiatives, not just contributions.
  • Represent Honeycomb at the community level in OpenTelemetry SIGs, setting direction on collectors, exporters, and instrumentation libraries the broader ecosystem depends on.
  • Spot whitespace in the OTel ecosystem that creates structural customer friction, and lead the effort to close it — upstream or through Honeycomb tooling.
  • Build reference architectures and integration guides that set the standard for effective instrumentation across common customer environments (Kubernetes, ECS, serverless).
  • Lead feature and architecture contributions to Honeycomb's own open source projects (Refinery, Honeycomb Collector Distro) that support managed service capabilities at scale.

Technical Backstop for the Field

  • Be the final technical authority Solutions Architects call when a deal goes deeper than any existing playbook — join live production troubleshooting, validate architecture decisions, and provide the infrastructure credibility that closes the company's most technically demanding evaluations.
  • Own the infrastructure and data pipeline narrative on the company's most strategic accounts, in partnership with SA leadership.
  • Lead architecture reviews, SLO workshops, and instrumentation deep-dives for the most complex customer environments (multi-cluster Kubernetes, hybrid cloud, high-cardinality workloads) — often advising customer VPs and C-suite directly.
  • Step into the highest-stakes customer-facing POCs and pilots as technical lead, standing up collector pools, configuring Refinery pipelines, and proving out integrations in the customer's actual environment.
  • Drive prioritization at the roadmap level by identifying strategic gaps between Honeycomb's product capabilities and what the company's largest customers need.

Internal Tooling, Mentorship & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build internal tools and UIs that change how the FRE function operates — deployment dashboards, rule management interfaces, and monitoring tooling used company-wide.
  • Drive alignment across Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Engineering by synthesizing field signal into a coherent picture others can act on.
  • Manage trade-offs across the FRE charter — managed services, technical escalation, open source, and field backstop — making prioritization calls that others follow.
  • Mentor IC3/IC4 engineers on career development, not just technical skills — helping them build the scope, judgment, and stakeholder navigation needed for their next level.
  • Communicate at the executive level with both Honeycomb leadership and customer C-suite when the situation demands it.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 9+ years in engineering, SRE, infrastructure, DevOps, or equivalent — with demonstrated Staff-level (or equivalent) technical scope and impact, not just tenure.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS strongly preferred) — you've deployed, scaled, and operated production clusters at scale, and set standards for how others do the same.
  • Strong AWS expertise across core services (EC2, EKS, ECS, ALB/NLB, VPC, PrivateLink, IAM, S3, Route53), with fluency in multi-account architecture design, service quotas, and cost optimization strategy.
  • A track record of senior incident command — not just participation in on-call, but owning incident response, triage, and postmortem process improvements at the function level.
  • Infrastructure as Code mastery (Terraform, Helm, Chef, Ansible) — you've architected modules and standards that other engineers build on, not just written your own.
  • Deep observability expertise: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, SLOs/SLIs, and the full instrumentation lifecycle, with a record of setting standards for others.
  • Strong command of OpenTelemetry (SDK, Collector architecture, processors, exporters, semantic conventions) or equivalent, including public community contribution and leadership.
  • Proficiency in at least two of: Go, Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, .NET — enough to read, instrument, and debug customer code at a deep level.
  • Excellent executive communication skills — equally credible with a customer's staff SRE and their VP or C-suite, and with Honeycomb's own leadership.
  • Demonstrated ability to set direction in ambiguous, high-pressure situations with no precedent — and to build the structure that lets others operate independently afterward.

Nice to Haves

  • Background leading customer-facing engineering functions — solutions architecture, field engineering, or technical consulting — where you've owned the technical answer a deal hinged on.
  • Track record of building platforms and organizational systems, not just tools, that let a team scale without proportional headcount.
  • Public recognition or a leadership role in the CNCF/OpenTelemetry ecosystem — maintainer status, SIG leadership, or conference speaking.
  • Familiarity with Honeycomb or event-based observability approaches.
  • Experience operating telemetry pipelines at scale (OTel Collectors, Refinery/sampling, tail-based sampling, pipeline reliability).
  • Experience with managed SaaS deployments, private cloud offerings, or multi-tenant infrastructure operations.
  • Prior experience at an observability, monitoring, or developer tools vendor.
  • Experience mentoring senior or staff-track engineers on scope and career progression.

$200,000—$240,000 USD

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend

We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. The 4DMT Talent Acquisition team must expressly engage agencies on any requisition. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

GENERAL SUMMARY:  

4DMT seeks a motivated and experienced Associate Clinical Trial Manager support the Company's clinical trial activities. This position will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of one or more phase 1-3 clinical trials including trial start up, conduct and close-out activities. This role requires strong, professional written and verbal communication skills, good organization and attention to detail, and the ability to consistently provide high quality work while managing competing priorities and maintaining tight timelines. This person must be interested in working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and be willing to work beyond their job scope to achieve department and company objectives.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:   

  • Coordinate tracking of a clinical trial(s) under the oversight of the Clinical Trial Management
  • Collect, track and conduct initial review for completeness of site regulatory documents for IP release and/or TMF filing
  • Organize, maintain and participate in audits and close out of the Trial Master File (TMF/eTMF)
  • Maintain multiple tracking spreadsheets following the progress of assigned clinical trials, such as study subject tracking, essential document tracking, and sample and investigational product tracking
  • Track and coordinate CRO and third-party vendor activities, including vendor provided meeting minutes, study updates and trackers
  • Receive and review all regulatory documents from sites (direct or through CRO) for accuracy and compliance to applicable SOPs and regulatory guidelines
  • Ensure timely updates are provided to CTM for updating of ‘Clinicaltrial.gov’ (site updates/changes)
  • Track and route new CDAs, contracts and Work Orders through established legal approval process (CTAs, MSAs, work/task orders)
  • Perform first pass review of all site and vendor invoices including tracking and generation of monthly/quarterly accruals for finance
  • Assist with the development of site tools and clinical trial start-up activities
  • Assist and/or contribute to the creation and maintenance of study materials for clinical studies, including but not limited to site and CRA training material, regulatory document templates, study binders, study plans/manuals, study communications and presentations
  • Assist in tracking of trial IP and development of Pharmacy Manuals
  • Participate in study vendor set up and specification process, as appropriate
  • Communicate directly with sites, Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and CRA/monitors to obtain updated information, essential documents, etc. to assist with driving start-up, study conduct, and/or close-out activities
  • Assist with tracking of clinical trial progress including status update reports, as requested
  • Assist with the organization, management and conduct of internal team meetings, investigator meetings and other trial-specific meetings, including minute taking and action item log tracking
  • Assist in tracking of clinical lab samples and central reader/lab data, including tracking of sample shipments and reconciliation
  • Utilize EDC/CTMS systems to acquire and synthesize data, metrics, or reports as necessary (enrollment data, randomizations, data cleaning, SAEs, etc.) for CTM, specific meetings or management updates
  • May assist CTM in tracking and follow-up of monitoring visit reports and unresolved issues
  • Willing to travel as business needs demand (<5% anticipated)
  • Other duties as may be assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:  

Education:

  • B.A./B.S. degree required

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of work experience supporting clinical trials

Other Qualifications/Skills:

  • Basic knowledge of clinical trial operations, ICH GCP Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Proficient computer skills, specifically with Microsoft Office Suite that include Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Outlook
  • Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities
  • Team oriented and ability to effectively collaborate with study team, cross-functional team members, and external partners

Travel: 30%

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areAquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.

Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.

At Emphasys PHA, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.

Who we need

Reporting to the CEO, we are hiring a Director of Product Management to lead and strengthen our Product function. As our new Director of Product Management, you will bring greater structure, discipline, and strategic direction to how we define, prioritize, and deliver our product roadmap. Leading a team of three Product Owners, you will establish stronger product management practices, coach and develop the team, and partner closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to connect customer needs and market opportunities with business priorities. You will balance strategy with hands-on leadership as we evolve our product offering, including the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States.

What’s in it for you

The opportunity to shape the Product function. You will step into a team with deep industry knowledge and an opportunity to introduce the product management structure, practices, and operating rhythm that will help it evolve. You will have the autonomy to strengthen roadmapping, prioritization, and agile ways of working while coaching a team that is ready to build its product management capabilities. Your experience will directly influence how the function operates and how product decisions are made.

A meaningful product transformation. You will help guide the evolution of an established software product as we continue moving from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform. You will have the opportunity to balance customer needs and commitments with innovation and technical investment, helping determine what we build, why it matters, and where we focus next.

Evolve how Product works with AI. You will help the Product team adopt and mature AI-enabled ways of working, including the emerging AI Delivery Life Cycle (AI-DLC) methodology. As these practices continue to evolve across the organization, you will help the team explore where AI can strengthen product discovery, decision-making, development, and delivery, encouraging thoughtful experimentation while establishing practical approaches that can scale.

Influence and visibility. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will have a voice in decisions that connect product direction with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth. You will work closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership and engage directly with customers, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to influence both product strategy and how that strategy comes to life.

How you will make an impact:

  • Set the product direction. You will define and communicate a clear product vision and strategy, connecting customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities. You will translate that direction into a longer-term roadmap that gives teams greater clarity on where we are going, why it matters, and what comes next.
  • Bring structure to product management. You will establish stronger product management practices, operating rhythms, and agile ways of working. You will bring greater discipline to prioritization, backlog management, planning, and decision-making, helping the team move from reactive delivery toward a more consistent and strategic approach.
  • Lead the evolution of the product. You will help guide the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based product. Partnering closely with Development, you will balance innovation, technical investment, customer commitments, and business priorities to support predictable, high-quality delivery.
  • Develop and empower the team. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of three Product Owners, building their product management capabilities and creating greater clarity around ownership and accountability. Initially operating as a player-coach, you will provide hands-on guidance while helping the team become increasingly strategic and effective.
  • Bring the customer into product decisions. You will engage directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities and bring those insights back into product strategy and planning. You will confidently present product direction, listen to feedback, and ensure customer needs are considered alongside broader market and business opportunities.
  • Connect Product across the business. You will partner with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to create stronger alignment around product priorities and opportunities. You will contribute product insight to positioning, packaging, pricing, strategic accounts, and growth discussions, helping connect product decisions to customer value and business outcomes.

Here’s what you bring:

  • The product leadership experience. You have led a product team and know how to build the structure, practices, and accountability that enable people to do their best work. You have experience coaching and developing Product Owners or Product Managers while remaining close enough to the work to provide practical, hands-on guidance when needed.
  • The strategic and operational mindset. You can translate customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into a clear product strategy and actionable roadmap. You know how to prioritize competing needs, make thoughtful trade-offs, and bring greater discipline and predictability to how product decisions are made and executed.
  • The product management discipline. You have worked within strong product management environments and understand agile principles, backlog management, roadmapping, prioritization, and product lifecycle practices. You can assess what is working, identify where greater structure is needed, and introduce processes that help a team become more strategic and effective without adding unnecessary complexity.
  • The customer focus. You are comfortable engaging directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities and using those insights to inform product decisions. You can present product direction with confidence, navigate differing perspectives, and build credibility with customers and industry stakeholders.
  • The cross-functional leadership. You can build trusted relationships across Development, Sales, Marketing, and leadership teams, bringing different perspectives together around shared priorities. You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences and can challenge assumptions, influence decisions, and push back constructively when needed.
  • The adaptability. You are comfortable joining an established business and product at an important point in its evolution. You bring curiosity and sound judgment to learning a specialized market and are open to exploring how emerging technologies, including AI-assisted development, can support better products and more effective ways of working.
  • The AI-forward mindset. You are curious about how AI is changing the product discipline and are motivated to explore how it can improve the way products are discovered, developed, and delivered. You may already have experience incorporating AI-enabled tools or methodologies into product practices, or you bring the curiosity and willingness to learn, experiment, and help a team adopt new ways of working as technologies and approaches continue to evolve.

Why join?

Aquila is a division of Constellation Software Inc., one of the largest and most successful software companies in Canada and the most successful technology stock in Canada over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fiber, you will thrive at Aquila.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • An interview with the CEO focused on your product leadership experience and your approach to building product management discipline, developing a team, and strengthening how product strategy and execution come together.
  • A final interview with members of the leadership team focused on your leadership approach, cross-functional collaboration, and how you would work across the organization to help evolve the Product function.

Aquila welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in companion animal health or outcomes research, ideally with multi market or global exposure and collaboration with clinics, referral centers, or practice networks
