Role summary

We are looking for an individual-contributor Marketing Orchestration Manager to turn fragmented GTM signals, tools, and motions into a coordinated account engagement engine. This role sits in a hybrid cross-functional model and is responsible for aligning Marketing, SDRs, and Sales around the highest-value, in-market accounts and ensuring those accounts are engaged in a connected, measurable way across channels.

This person serves as the orchestration leader for signal-based GTM execution. They connect buying intent, account prioritization, channel activation, and execution visibility so teams can focus effort where it matters most, reduce wasted activity, and improve pipeline efficiency. This role partners closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, SDR leadership, Sales, analytics, and RevOps to create a more unified and controllable account-based execution model.

Primary objectives

  • Unified Account Prioritization Across GTM: Create a single, signal-driven view of the highest-value, in-market accounts so Marketing, SDRs, and Sales are aligned on where to focus and why
  • Increased Pipeline Efficiency and Conversion: Improve pipeline performance by coordinating inbound and outbound activations around accounts with verified buying intent
  • Visibility and Control of GTM Execution: Provide leadership with a control-tower view of how priority accounts are being engaged across channels, teams, and tools
  • Maximized ROI on Data and MarTech Investments: Turn fragmented platforms and data sources into a unified orchestration engine that improves pipeline impact

Key responsibilities

  • Own the cross-functional model for identifying, tiering, and activating high-value, in-market accounts across Marketing, SDR, and Sales motions
  • Translate intent signals, fit data, engagement behavior, and account priorities into clear activation rules and GTM action paths
  • Build and maintain a unified view of target-account prioritization across signal sources and engagement systems
  • Orchestrate coordinated activation across owned, paid, email, SDR, web, campaign, and conversational channels so teams are acting on the same account intelligence
  • Partner with Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, SDR leadership, Revenue Operations, and Sales to align account selection, routing, sequencing, and engagement strategy
  • Define and improve the operating logic for when and how accounts move into prioritized plays, accelerated follow-up, or coordinated outbound and inbound motions
  • Create leadership visibility into account engagement coverage, channel overlap, execution gaps, and signal-to-activation performance
  • Develop dashboards, scorecards, or reporting frameworks that give stakeholders a control-tower view of GTM execution against priority accounts
  • Identify duplication, inefficiency, and channel conflict in account engagement motions and implement improvements that reduce wasted effort
  • Partner with system owners to connect data, workflows, and activation tools across platforms such as 6sense, TechTarget, HG Insights, Qualified, CRM, marketing automation, and related GTM systems
  • Improve the return on data and martech investments by increasing adoption, reducing fragmentation, and ensuring tools contribute to measurable pipeline outcomes
  • Establish governance, definitions, and shared ways of working for account prioritization, orchestration logic, and execution handoffs
  • Work with analytics partners to measure the impact of orchestration on conversion, pipeline progression, speed to follow-up, and account engagement quality

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation, revenue marketing, campaign operations, ABM, lifecycle marketing, or a related GTM discipline
  • Experience using account signals, intent data, engagement data, and firmographic or technographic inputs to guide marketing or sales activation
  • Proven ability to drive alignment across Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Operations teams without direct authority
  • Strong understanding of B2B funnel mechanics, lead and account lifecycle concepts, and pipeline creation motions
  • Experience building or improving operational frameworks that connect insight, prioritization, and execution across teams
  • Familiarity with martech and data platforms used in signal-based GTM, such as intent providers, conversation platforms, CRM, marketing automation, and reporting tools
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and translate findings into action
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence decisions across functions and levels
  • Strong organizational judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage ambiguity in fast-moving environments

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology marketing
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing, buying-group signals, and intent-driven GTM strategies
  • Experience partnering closely with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, SDR teams, or Sales leadership
  • Working knowledge of platforms such as 6sense, TechTarget, HG Insights, Qualified, Salesforce, and marketing automation tools
  • Experience building reporting frameworks or dashboards that improve GTM visibility and actionability

Success in this role

In the first 6 to 12 months, success would look like:

  • A shared, trusted framework exists for identifying and prioritizing high-value, in-market accounts across Marketing, SDRs, and Sales
  • Priority accounts are receiving more coordinated engagement across inbound, outbound, paid, owned, email, web, and campaign motions
  • Leaders have clearer visibility into which accounts are being engaged, where overlap or gaps exist, and how effectively teams are acting on signals
  • Fewer resources are wasted on low-priority or weak-intent accounts because activation is more tightly tied to verified buying signals
  • Data and martech investments are better connected, more consistently adopted, and more directly linked to pipeline impact
  • Stakeholders see measurable improvement in conversion efficiency, speed to action, and overall orchestration of GTM execution

jobs.description:
NORTH CAROLINA REMOTE PSYCHIATRIC-MENTAL HEALTH NURSE PRACTITIONER (PMHNP)

Initiating Visit & Supervising Practitioner : Principal Illness Navigation, Peer Support (PIN-PS)

Independent Contractor (1099) | Telehealth/ Remote position | You Are Accountable

ABOUT THE ROLE

You Are Accountable operates behavioral health programs built around Principal Illness Navigation – Peer Support (PIN-PS), a Medicare care-navigation benefit in which certified peer support specialists walk alongside patients living with serious behavioral health conditions. Every patient's navigation episode must begin with a qualifying initiating visit furnished by a billing practitioner, and the ongoing peer navigation is billed incident to that practitioner's services under general supervision. That practitioner is you.

This is a flexible, telehealth-based contractor role with meaningful clinical leverage: you conduct the psychiatric evaluation that opens each patient's episode, set the plan of care the peer team supports, and remain available as the supervising clinician while peer specialists deliver month-to-month navigation. You control your own schedule, and compensation scales directly with the work you personally perform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Conduct initiating visits (e.g., psychiatric diagnostic evaluations, CPT 90791, or E/M visits) via telehealth for patients entering PIN-PS programs, establishing the diagnosis, medical necessity, and plan of care the navigation services will support.
  • Document each visit in our EHR within 48 hours to clean, billable standards, including patient consent to navigation services where required.
  • Serve as the billing practitioner of record for enrolled patients and provide general supervision of the certified peer support specialists furnishing navigation incident to your services.
  • Furnish follow-up visits for your enrolled patients where clinically indicated and mutually agreed.
  • Cooperate with quality, audit, and payer-compliance activities relating to your patients.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Active, unrestricted APRN/NP licensure in one or more of: Texas, Florida, North Carolina, Tennessee, Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or New York (multi-state licensure a plus). State credential titles vary (APRN, CRNP, APN, NP) — all are welcome.
  • National board certification as a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC).
  • Any physician collaboration, supervision, or protocol arrangement required by your state (e.g., prescriptive authority agreement in TX; collaborative agreement in PA; joint protocol in NJ; practice agreement or NP Modernization Act qualification in NY; supervisory protocol in FL) — we can discuss support here. We also have physicians that we work with that can provide this.
  • Active NPI; eligibility to enroll with and reassign benefits to our professional entities for Medicare and Medicaid; never excluded from any federal or state health care program.
  • Comfort with telehealth care for adults with serious behavioral health conditions, and an appreciation for peer support as part of the care team.

COMPENSATION

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote — Global Compensation: Open / Competitive based on experience About LogicsticsLogicstics is a rapidly growing international moving company and freight forwarder specializing in household goods relocations worldwide.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote — Global Compensation: Open / Competitive based on experience

About Logicstics

Logicstics is a rapidly growing international moving company and freight forwarder specializing in household goods relocations worldwide. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service, innovative technology, and making international relocations as seamless as possible.

We are seeking an experienced General Manager to lead and grow our International Moving Division.

This is a senior leadership position for someone who already has significant, hands-on experience in the international moving industry. We are not looking for a general logistics manager who needs to learn international moving.

The successful candidate should already have a firm understanding of how an international moving company operates and be capable of taking significant day-to-day responsibility off ownership.

About the Role

The General Manager will oversee the day-to-day performance of the International Moving Division and take ownership across:

  • Sales
  • Operations
  • Pricing
  • Sales Support
  • Customer Service

You will lead teams, establish accountability, improve processes, develop employees, manage escalations, and ensure the division operates efficiently while continuing to grow.

This is a hands-on leadership position requiring someone who can move comfortably between strategy, people management, operational problem-solving, and execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the day-to-day operations of the International Moving Division.
  • Oversee Sales, Operations, Pricing, Sales Support, and Customer Service functions.
  • Recruit, train, coach, and manage remote employees and department leaders.
  • Establish KPIs and performance standards across departments.
  • Hold teams accountable for results and operational execution.
  • Improve sales processes, close rates, workflows, and customer experience.
  • Review pricing strategies and ensure quotes are accurate, competitive, and commercially sound.
  • Coach sales representatives and improve overall sales performance.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.
  • Handle complex and escalated customer situations professionally.
  • Develop, document, and improve SOPs across the division.
  • Ensure proper coordination between sales, pricing, operations, and customer service.
  • Maintain compliance with international shipping regulations and industry best practices.
  • Work directly with ownership on growth initiatives, technology implementation, hiring, and strategic planning.
  • Take meaningful operational responsibility away from ownership so leadership can focus on broader growth opportunities.

Requirements

Required Industry Experience

Direct international moving experience is non-negotiable.

Candidates must have significant professional experience working specifically within an international moving company or international household goods division.

General freight, transportation, supply chain, or logistics experience without international moving experience will not be sufficient.

Candidates should have extensive knowledge of:

  • International household goods moving
  • International moving operations
  • Ocean freight
  • Air freight
  • Customs procedures
  • International shipping documentation
  • Origin and destination services
  • International moving pricing and quoting
  • Shipment coordination
  • Customer escalations
  • International moving industry standards and processes

Required Leadership Experience

  • Ideally 10+ years of international household goods moving experience.
  • Significant experience managing operations for an international moving company or major international moving division.
  • Proven experience leading teams and developing employees.
  • Experience overseeing multiple functions such as Operations, Sales, Pricing, Sales Support, and Customer Service.
  • Ability to establish KPIs and manage teams against measurable performance expectations.
  • Strong coaching and performance-management capabilities.
  • Experience resolving complex customer and operational escalations.
  • Strong commercial understanding of pricing, profitability, sales performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High level of computer proficiency.

Experience with CRM, transportation-management, and workflow software is highly preferred.

Experience working with the U.S. international moving market is a strong advantage.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

  • An international moving industry veteran who can contribute immediately.
  • A hands-on operator, not someone who only manages from a distance.
  • Comfortable making decisions independently.
  • Commercially minded and understands the relationship between pricing, sales, operations, and profitability.
  • Process-driven and capable of bringing structure to a growing organization.
  • Strong at coaching employees and improving team performance.
  • Comfortable handling difficult customer and operational situations.
  • Accountable and results-oriented.
  • Able to identify problems before they become larger issues.
  • Comfortable working directly with ownership in an entrepreneurial environment.

Benefits

Compensation

Open and based on experience.

Logicstics recognizes that this is a highly specialized and valuable leadership position and is prepared to pay competitively for the right candidate.

Compensation will be evaluated based on the candidate's international moving experience, leadership scope, operational expertise, and ability to take ownership of the division.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Paid training and onboarding
  • Long-term career growth
  • Significant ownership and influence over the International Moving Division
  • Opportunity to shape processes, teams, technology, and future growth
  • Direct collaboration with company ownership

Important: Due to the specialized nature of this position, only candidates with substantial direct international moving experience will be considered.

jobs.excerpt: About TuneIn TuneIn, the world’s leading live audio service, brings together live radio, sports, news, music, podcasts, and audiobooks from around the globe.
jobs.description:
About TuneIn

TuneIn, the world’s leading live audio service, brings together live radio, sports, news, music, podcasts, and audiobooks from around the globe. With more than 75 million monthly active users, TuneIn is one of the world's most widely used audio platforms. TuneIn broadcasts over 100,000 owned & operated and partner radio stations. With premier distribution across 200 platforms and connected devices including Tesla and Alexa, TuneIn empowers listeners to hear what they love wherever they are, including exclusive commercial-free stations from the minds of folks like Garth Brooks. TuneIn Premium subscribers get additional exclusive access to commercial-free news from top networks like CNN, Fox News Radio, MSNBC, and Bloomberg, as well as live, can't-miss F1, MLB, NHL, and college sports. For more information, please visit us at Tunein.com or follow us on Instagram, or X.

Our engineering teams build and operate highly available, globally distributed systems that power one of the world's largest live audio platforms. We're looking for a technical leader who is excited about operating reliable infrastructure at scale while enabling engineers to move faster through automation, modern tooling, and operational excellence.

About the Position

TuneIn is looking for a Director of Tech Ops & IT to lead the teams and technologies responsible for our production infrastructure, cloud operations, site reliability, infrastructure automation, corporate IT, and internal technology services.

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own TuneIn's cloud platform, including infrastructure security, observability, operational excellence, maintenance, and cost optimization. This role also leads key aspects of our corporate IT function, including technology governance, incident response, and vendor management. You'll manage engineers supporting both cross-functional platform capabilities and embedded engineering teams aligned to key business initiatives.

You'll lead a multidisciplinary team of seven direct reports across Infrastructure Automation, Tech Operations, Security, and Corporate IT.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building high-performing teams, driving operational maturity, improving engineering productivity, and balancing long-term strategy with hands-on technical leadership.

What You'll Do
Engineering Operations & Reliability

  • Drive operational excellence across TuneIn's production systems, ensuring high availability, scalability, resiliency, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Lead reliability initiatives, including observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and service level objectives (SLOs).
  • Partner with Engineering teams to improve deployment velocity, operational readiness, and production reliability.
  • Continuously improve CI/CD platforms, developer tooling, and self-service capabilities that enable engineering teams to build and ship faster.
  • Lead major production incidents, root cause analyses, and postmortems while driving long-term corrective actions.
  • Establish and continuously improve the team's on-call practices, participating in the rotation as needed.

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and evolution of TuneIn's cloud infrastructure, platform services, and infrastructure automation.
  • Define AWS infrastructure strategy, governance, IAM, networking, Kubernetes platform, cloud architecture, and infrastructure lifecycle management.
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code and automation-first practices across AWS and Kubernetes environments.
  • Oversee production networking, DNS, cloud identity, cloud security tooling, and platform services.
  • Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, forecasting, and operational reporting.
  • Oversee infrastructure automation using technologies such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native tooling.
  • Ensure platform architecture evolves to support future business growth while maintaining reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

Security

  • Refine, implement, and monitor security policies related to network perimeter security, access controls, and infrastructure inventory.
  • Facilitate regular security reviews, penetration testing, security awareness initiatives, and bug bounty programs.
  • Partner with Data Engineering to implement and oversee data inventory, minimization, and retention policies.
  • Own and continuously improve TuneIn's incident response plan, serving as the incident response coordinator during security events.
  • Support information security policy reviews with partners, customers, and certification bodies.

Corporate IT

  • Lead TuneIn's corporate IT function, including endpoint management, identity and access management, SaaS administration, helpdesk operations, asset lifecycle management, and employee onboarding/offboarding.
  • Oversee internal collaboration technologies, conferencing systems, office technology, and enterprise productivity platforms.
  • Manage vendor relationships, software licensing, renewals, procurement, and IT budget planning.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging technologies, including AI-enabled productivity tools, that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvements to the employee technology experience across the organization.

Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Technical Operations organization.
  • Establish clear priorities, metrics, and operational processes across the team.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships with Engineering, Security, Product, Finance, and People teams.
  • Influence technical direction across the organization through architecture reviews, operational best practices, and technical leadership.
  • Develop operational roadmaps aligned with company objectives and engineering priorities.
  • Communicate infrastructure health, operational metrics, security posture, and strategic initiatives to engineering leadership.

What We're Looking For

This is a hands-on technology leadership role spanning production infrastructure, SRE, cloud platform, security operations, and corporate IT. We're looking for a leader who has both managed technical organizations and maintained enough technical depth to guide architecture, operational decisions, and major incidents.

Language Requirement

Professional fluency in English is required for this role because the position leads and collaborates with technology teams and stakeholders across Canada and internationally. The role requires regular communication in English with technical and non-technical stakeholders, as well as the ability to conduct complex technical discussions, review technical documentation, and communicate with internal and external partners in English.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, cloud operations, platform engineering, site reliability, or technical operations.
  • 5+ years of engineering management experience leading technical teams.
  • Experience operating large-scale production environments on AWS.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes, containerized infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or Pulumi), and modern CI/CD platforms.
  • Strong understanding of observability platforms including Datadog, Prometheus, Graphana or similar technologies.
  • Experience leading incident response, operational excellence programs, disaster recovery planning, and production reliability initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of networking, IAM, cloud security, and distributed systems architecture.
  • Experience managing enterprise IT environments including identity management, endpoint management, SaaS ecosystems, and employee technology.
  • Proven ability to drive automation, improve engineering productivity, and reduce operational complexity.
  • Experience balancing reliability, performance, security, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on technical background with the credibility to guide architectural decisions while empowering engineers to execute.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting high-scale consumer internet or streaming platforms.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Cloudflare, Route53, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust networking, modern endpoint management, and enterprise security best practices.
  • Experience managing globally distributed engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting compliance, privacy, and security initiatives in partnership with Security teams.

Our Benefits & Compensation

  • Coverage of premium health plans for employees and eligible dependents, including dental and vision plans.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Wellness stipend.
  • Technology stipend.
  • Individual training and educational spending.
  • WFH one-time stipend.

Workforce Privacy Policy

Directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique

Lieu : Canada / À distance

À propos de TuneIn

Chez TuneIn, nous réinventons l’écoute pour un monde connecté. Nous réunissons des événements sportifs en direct, les dernières actualités, de la musique, des podcasts et plus de 100 000 stations de radio, afin de diffuser du contenu à des millions d’auditeurs via les mobiles, le Web, les véhicules connectés, les enceintes intelligentes, les téléviseurs, les appareils portables et des centaines d’appareils intégrés à travers le monde.

Nos équipes d’ingénieurs développent et exploitent des systèmes hautement disponibles et répartis à l’échelle mondiale, qui alimentent l’une des plus grandes plateformes audio en direct au monde. À propos du poste

TuneIn recherche un directeur des opérations techniques et de l'informatique pour diriger les équipes et les technologies en charge de notre infrastructure de production, des opérations cloud, de la fiabilité du site, de l'automatisation de l'infrastructure, de l'informatique d'entreprise et des services technologiques internes.

Nous recherchons un responsable technologique expérimenté qui prendra en charge la plateforme cloud de TuneIn, notamment la sécurité de l’infrastructure, l’observabilité, l’excellence opérationnelle, la maintenance et l’optimisation des coûts. Ce poste implique également la gestion d’aspects clés de notre fonction informatique d’entreprise, notamment la gouvernance technologique, la gestion des incidents et la gestion des fournisseurs. Vous dirigerez des ingénieurs chargés à la fois des capacités transversales de la plateforme et des équipes d’ingénierie embarquées alignées sur les initiatives commerciales clés.

Vous dirigerez une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de sept collaborateurs qui vous relèveront directement, issus des domaines de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure, des opérations techniques, de la sécurité et de l’informatique d’entreprise.

Ce poste est idéal pour une personne qui aime constituer des équipes hautement performantes, favoriser la maturité opérationnelle, améliorer la productivité de l’ingénierie et concilier stratégie à long terme et leadership technique sur le terrain.

Votre quotidien

Opérations d'ingénierie et fiabilité

  • Assurer l'excellence opérationnelle des systèmes de production de TuneIn, en garantissant une haute disponibilité, une évolutivité, une résilience, une sécurité et une rentabilité optimales.

  • Améliorer en continu les plateformes CI/CD, les outils de développement et les fonctionnalités en libre-service qui permettent aux équipes d’ingénierie de développer et de déployer plus rapidement.

  • Mettre en place et améliorer en continu les pratiques de permanence de l’équipe, en participant à la rotation si nécessaire.

Infrastructure et plateforme cloud

  • Diriger la stratégie, la feuille de route et l’évolution de l’infrastructure cloud, des services de plateforme et de l’automatisation de l’infrastructure de TuneIn.
  • Définir la stratégie d’infrastructure AWS, la gouvernance, la gestion des identités et des accès (IAM), la mise en réseau, la plateforme Kubernetes, l’architecture cloud et la gestion du cycle de vie de l’infrastructure.
  • Promouvoir l’Infrastructure comme Code et les pratiques axées sur l’automatisation dans les environnements AWS et Kubernetes.
  • Superviser la mise en réseau en production, le DNS, l’identité cloud, les outils de sécurité cloud et les services de plateforme.

  • Veiller à ce que l’architecture de la plateforme évolue pour soutenir la croissance future de l’entreprise tout en maintenant la fiabilité, l’évolutivité et l’efficacité opérationnelle.

Sécurité

  • Affiner, mettre en œuvre et surveiller les politiques de sécurité relatives à la sécurité du périmètre réseau, aux contrôles d’accès et à l’inventaire de l’infrastructure.
  • Organiser régulièrement des audits de sécurité, des tests d’intrusion, des initiatives de sensibilisation à la sécurité et des programmes de prime aux bogues.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie des données pour mettre en œuvre et superviser les politiques d’inventaire, de minimisation et de conservation des données.
  • Gérer et améliorer en permanence le plan d’intervention en cas d’incident de TuneIn, en jouant le rôle de coordinateur de la réponse aux incidents lors d’événements de sécurité.
  • Accompagner les révisions des politiques de sécurité de l’information avec les partenaires, les clients et les organismes de certification.

Informatique d’entreprise

  • Diriger la fonction informatique de TuneIn, notamment la gestion des terminaux, la gestion des identités et des accès, l'administration des solutions SaaS, les opérations du service d'assistance, la gestion du cycle de vie des actifs, ainsi que l'intégration et le départ des collaborateurs.
  • Superviser les technologies de collaboration interne, les systèmes de visioconférence, les équipements bureautiques et les plateformes de productivité d’entreprise.
  • Gérer les relations avec les fournisseurs, les licences logicielles, les renouvellements, les achats et la planification du budget informatique.
  • Évaluer et mettre en œuvre les technologies émergentes, notamment les outils de productivité basés sur l’IA, qui améliorent l’expérience des collaborateurs et l’efficacité opérationnelle.
  • Conduire une amélioration continue de l’expérience technologique des collaborateurs à l’échelle de l’organisation.

Leadership

  • Mettre en place, encadrer et développer une structure d'opérations techniques hautement performante.
  • Définir des priorités, des indicateurs et des processus opérationnels clairs pour l’ensemble de l’équipe.
  • Favoriser des partenariats interfonctionnels solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de sécurité, de produit, de finance et des ressources humaines.
  • Influencer l’orientation technique de l’ensemble de l’organisation par le biais de revues d’architecture, de bonnes pratiques opérationnelles et d’un leadership technique.
  • Élaborer des feuilles de route opérationnelles alignées sur les objectifs de l’entreprise et les priorités d’ingénierie.
  • Communiquer à la direction de l’ingénierie l’état de l’infrastructure, les indicateurs opérationnels, le niveau de sécurité et les initiatives stratégiques.

Ce que nous recherchons

Il s’agit d’un poste de leadership technologique à la fois stratégique et très opérationnel, couvrant les infrastructures de production, le SRE, les plateformes infonuagiques, les opérations de sécurité et l’IT d’entreprise. Exigence linguistique

jobs.excerpt: OVERVIEWReporting to the Sr.  Manager of Post-Collection Operations, the Recycling Materials Marketing and Recovery Manager will lead the management of commodity marketing contracts and direct recycling agreements with secondary processors.
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Post-Collection Operations, the Recycling Materials Marketing and Recovery Manager will lead the management of commodity marketing contracts and direct recycling agreements with secondary processors. This role is responsible for ensuring the efficient movement of materials through the system, optimizing revenue, and maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements. The MMRM will oversee material flow, performance tracking, and day-to-day issue resolution across marketing and processing partners, while working closely with internal teams to ensure accurate reporting, financial alignment, and achievement of regulatory recovery targets.

This is a full-time position, salaried paid and requires residency in Canada.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage commodity marketing agreements and direct contracts with secondary processors/end-markets, including performance, compliance, and commercial outcomes.
  • Track and manage material flow from preconditioning facilities to end-markets, ensuring continuity of movement and timely issue resolution.
  • Monitor material composition and quality, working with operations and audit teams to identify risks, discrepancies, and improvement opportunities.
  • Calculate and validate facility yields and recovery performance, ensuring alignment with contractual and regulatory expectations.
  • Ensure accurate and complete reporting from service providers, including reconciliation of volumes, revenues, and performance metrics.
  • Act as the primary liaison between post-collection operations, marketing agents, finance, audit, and service provider reporting teams to resolve daily operational and financial issues.
  • Work closely with post-collection operations managers to address processing, logistics, and material quality challenges impacting marketability and revenue.
  • Develop and maintain monthly and quarterly reports on:
    • Commodity market performance,
    • Marketing partner performance,
    • Revenue per ton and yield trends
    • Risks and opportunities.
  • Assess and support new market development opportunities, including domestic and export end-markets, to improve system resilience and maximize revenue.
  • Support contract implementation, change orders, and ongoing optimization of processing and marketing arrangements.
  • Proactively identify and resolve operational, contractual, and market-related issues impacting system performance.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Post-secondary education in business, supply chain, environmental management, or related fields is preferred.
  • An equivalent combination of education, and experiences may be considered.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in commodity marketing, recycling markets, or materials trading, with direct exposure to plastics, fiber, or metals markets.
  • Experience managing commercial contracts with processors, brokers, or end-markets.
  • Demonstrated experience tracking material flows, yields, and revenue performance within recycling or commodity supply chains.

Knowledge/Competencies/Skills

  • Preference will be given to candidates with a strong understanding of artificial intelligence (AI) concepts and the ability to communicate and apply AI technologies effectively within a business context.
  • Strong understanding of recycling commodity markets, pricing mechanisms, and end-market requirements.
  • Experience with data analysis, yield calculations, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to manage day-to-day operational issues across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working with operations, finance, audit, and reporting teams.
  • High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and accountability.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Self-starter with a high degree of motivation and ownership, able to operate independently and drive outcomes.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and data analysis tools; experience with reporting systems and dashboards is an asset.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • All CM employees work 40 hours per week, remotely from a Canadian home office environment.
  • Extra or flexible hours may be required on occasion. The job demands that the incumbent have a flexible work schedule with periods of uneven workload.
  • This role requires field work. As a result, there will be some variability in scheduling to accommodate operational needs.
  • A valid Driver’s license is required, and comprehensive vehicle insurance is required.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a key player in our Analytics Engineering & BI team, you'll be at the forefront of how Power Digital designs, governs, and scales its Looker semantic layer. A critical part of your role will be owning the semantic layer modeling that powers every data product we ship, and making sure that layer serves multiple analytics surfaces including conversational analytics. You'll translate ambiguous stakeholder asks into flexible, durable models, ship best-in-class data products, and make sure every consumer of that model, human or AI, gets the right answer every time.

Responsibilities:

- Own and evolve Power Digital's enterprise LookML semantic layer as the governed foundation for analytics across our 1,000+ person organization and 600+ clients.
- Write scalable and performant LookML with rich metadata to support emerging conversational analytics use cases
- Translate ambiguous stakeholder and client asks into clear technical implementations, then design and optimize Looker assets that support scalable, reusable self-service analytics.
- Build best-in-class data products in Looker for internal stakeholders and clients, applying strong data visualization and UI/UX principles.
- Design LookML for scale and performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering on aggregate layer tuning and query optimization, and deploy and govern LookML across multiple Looker instances.
- Own the LookML style guide and naming conventions, train and support users adopting self-service analytics, and mentor junior developers and analysts.
- Employ AI technologies to maximize team leverage and efficiency.
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years owning the full lifecycle of production-grade LookML models and data products
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and BigQuery preferred).
  • Strong foundation in dimensional modeling and data warehousing fundamentals.
  • Agency experience, including performance marketing analytics. Comfortable with the measurement, channels, and multi-client pace of a digital marketing agency serving multiple clients from eComm to B2B
  • Experience deploying and governing LookML across multiple Looker instances.
  • Experience with extensible LookML and modular visualizations in a multi-tenant environment
  • Experience mentoring and leveling-up the technical expertise of junior team members.
  • Experience with git-based version control and CI/CD workflows.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable with both engineers and executives.

Nice to have:

    • Experience routing LLM queries (directing natural-language questions to the right model/Explore.)
    • Conversational Analytics or comparable natural-language BI tooling experience.
    • Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools for accelerated LookML development
    • dbt or equivalent analytics engineering experience

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Reuse / leverage ratio: within the first 6 months, achieve >50% of client-facing reporting delivered from shared, governed semantic components (vs. bespoke client-specific LookML). Thereafter, maintain >= 75% quarter-over-quarter, measured from Looker content lineage
- Self-service deflection: within the first 6 months, increase the share of analytical questions resolved by users independently (Self-Service functionality or Omega) to 50% vs. adhoc requests from Asana and Slack. Thereafter, maintain >= 75%
- Source-of-truth integrity: hold production metric-definition discrepancies and data-quality incidents at < 5%, reconciled at each monthly close across Looker and downstream surfaces (Pacing Sheets, LLMs).
- User Experience: 95% of production data products load in 5 seconds or less, measured weekly
- Code quality: 95% style-guide and naming-convention conformance, measured monthly

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Establish and maintain the LookML style guide, naming conventions, and metric-definition source of truth the rest of the team builds against.
- Deliver the highest-priority Looker data products for active client and internal engagements on committed timelines.
- Build and ensure routing scalability of the field-level semantic metadata required for Conversational Analytics and AI-driven queries.
- Partner with Analytics Engineering to methodically tune diagnose and clear performance bottlenecks on production data products.
- Mentor and deputize junior developers through hands-on PR review and pairing on modeling and visualization work.

Position Title

Credit Products Manager

Location

Work From Home TX, TX 73301

Job Summary

The Credit Products Manager (CPM) is responsible for overseeing first-line credit underwriting and portfolio management within an assigned business including but not limited to Corporate Banking and Regional Commercial Banking, ensuring alignment with the bank’s risk appetite and business objectives. This role manages a team of underwriters and credit professionals (Credit Products Specialists and Credit Products Analysts), ensuring accurate risk ratings, loan evaluation and underwriting, and ongoing portfolio management. Utilizing data-driven insights and portfolio analytics, a CPM identifies emerging risks and opportunities, providing recommendations to leadership to support sound credit decisions. Collaborating with sales, risk, and technology teams, this role helps drive responsible growth, improve underwriting processes, and enhance credit product offerings. With a focus on operational execution, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement, a CPM plays a key role in maintaining portfolio quality and supporting the bank’s long-term success.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Maintains visibility and deep knowledge of bank relationships within the assigned LOB to ensure alignment with business objectives.
  • Executes on the strategic priorities set by the Head of Credit Products, Line of Business leaders, Credit Products Senior Director and 2nd and 3rd Line Risk partners to ensure alignment with enterprise goals.
  • Proactively identifies and escalates areas for improvement in credit processes, policies and procedures.
  • Maintains the credit quality of assigned portfolios and/or lending verticals by overseeing underwriting, portfolio management, and risk monitoring activities.
  • Establishes and fosters a shared vision across assigned regions and verticals, ensuring consistency in credit decisioning and risk management practices.
  • Attracts, develops, and retains top talent within Credit Products by providing leadership, coaching, and professional development opportunities for underwriters, portfolio managers, and credit analysts.
  • Collaborates closely with Sales, Credit Products, and Risk teams to drive responsible growth, optimize credit decisioning, and enhance portfolio performance.
  • Serves as a key point of contact for deal flow assignment, credit risk reviews, and escalations, ensuring timely and well-informed credit decisions.
  • Leverages data-driven insights and analytics to identify emerging credit risks and opportunities, proactively adjusting strategies as needed.
  • Well versed in legal documentation (e.g., Credit Agreements) and positioned to both develop more junior associates on the topic and interact with internal and external legal counsel and negotiate terms directly with clients.
  • Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk frameworks while supporting continuous process improvements.
  • Provides credit risk reporting and analysis to senior leadership, contributing to portfolio strategy and risk management discussions.
  • Partners with legal and compliance teams to ensure underwriting and portfolio management practices align with all regulatory requirements.
  • Supports senior leadership in delivering portfolio analysis and reporting, contributing to strategic decision-making.
  • Recruits, develops and trains top credit underwriting and portfolio management talent.

ADDITIONAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Performs special projects, to include continuous improvement and transformation initiatives, and additional duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Consistently adheres to regulatory and compliance policies and standards linked to the job as listed and complete required compliance trainings. Accountable to maintain compliance with applicable federal, state and local laws and regulations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate Degree (4 years or equivalent) in Business, Economics or related field and Master's Degree (or Postgraduate equivalent) .
  • Minimum experience preferred: 12+ Years of 1st line of defense credit underwriting, portfolio management, and risk management experience within the Financial Industry including credit strategy and credit analytics.
  • 5+ years of experience in managing teams of credit analysts, underwriters in the specialty vertical.
  • 5+ years of experience in the direct specialized line of business (Specialized commercial industries, capital markets, corporate commercial banking, etc.)
  • Experience and expertise in credit bureaus, credit decision engines, credit and cash flow modeling for underwriting and portfolio management decisions, income/identity verification and loss forecasting.

Job Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of federal and state laws and regulations related to credit decisions, ensuring compliance in underwriting and portfolio management.
  • For certain LOBs (e.g., Corporate Banking and Specialized Industries), a strong working knowledge of the syndicated loan market and related processes.
  • Proficiency in credit bureaus, credit decision engines, underwriting models, and portfolio management strategies, with experience in income/identity verification and risk assessment.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate credit analysis into actionable strategies and policies for key stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to contribute to business strategy by incorporating industry knowledge and market trends into credit risk assessments and recommendations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and execute tasks efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low-level sensor integration and motion planning to high-level perception and behavioral systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep working knowledge of robotics frameworks, real-time systems, and sensor fusion. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop robotics software in C++ and Python, with strong attention to real-time performance and reliability.
  • Design and integrate sensor data pipelines including cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and proprioceptive sensors.
  • Implement perception, localization, and mapping algorithms including SLAM and sensor fusion, integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and other sensors into robust real-world state estimation.
  • Develop motion planning, control, and trajectory generation algorithms that respect kinematic and dynamic constraints while delivering smooth, predictable, and safe robot behavior in production environments.
  • Build behavioral systems using state machines, behavior trees, or task planners.
  • Integrate ROS / ROS 2 frameworks with custom hardware and embedded systems.
  • Implement safety-critical patterns including watchdogs, fault detection, and safe stops.
  • Build simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) for development and testing.
  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and ML engineers, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Design and execute field tests, including data collection and post-test analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging robotics technologies and frameworks, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of robotics software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
  • Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2 in production projects.
  • Solid experience with at least one of perception, localization, motion planning, or control.
  • Familiarity with sensor fusion and Kalman/particle filter techniques.
  • Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo).
  • Strong debugging skills in real-time and concurrent systems.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting field tests and hardware integration.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Robotics or related field.
  • Exposure to autonomous vehicles, drones, or industrial automation.
  • Experience with safety-critical software (ISO 26262, IEC 61508).
  • Familiarity with ML-based perception pipelines.
  • Open-source contributions in robotics.

jobs.title: Director of Project Management Office (PMO)
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityAs Director, Project Management Office, you'll own the PMO function globally and help build the delivery framework that enables Sitetracker's Solution Delivery organization to scale while making project execution more predictable, measurable, and profitable.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As Director, Project Management Office, you'll own the PMO function globally and help build the delivery framework that enables Sitetracker's Solution Delivery organization to scale while making project execution more predictable, measurable, and profitable. As project volume grows and more delivery moves across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and our Delivery Center in India, you'll establish the governance, financial visibility, and operating discipline needed to scale without tying growth directly to headcount.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who builds the method and then gets an organization to use it. You'll work directly with the SVP of Solution Delivery, with visibility to the CCO and COO, and influence how projects are governed across the business—from readiness and scope control through earned value, margin, utilization, and close-out. You'll also have the opportunity to shape how emerging areas like Scout and AI services fit into a global delivery model built for tomorrow.

What You'll Do

You'll build and own the global operating framework for Solution Delivery, creating consistency across regions. You'll establish lifecycle phases and meaningful readiness gates, define project classifications based on complexity, create standardized project plans across Sitetracker offerings, and build a close-out process that feeds lessons back into Product and scoping. You'll turn readiness from a form into a real assessment with clear ownership, completion criteria, mitigation plans, and accountability.

You'll bring financial rigor into project and portfolio governance by establishing earned value tracking and improving visibility into margin, revenue forecasting, utilization, and overall project health. You'll create a consistent Project Get to Green approach for Yellow and Red projects, strengthen Salesforce and PSA data quality, and give leadership a trusted view of the portfolio that allows the organization to act on risk rather than simply report it.

You'll also shape how work is staffed globally as Sitetracker expands its offshore Delivery Center capabilities. You'll establish capacity planning, staffing rules, utilization targets, and governance around non-billable work, with the goal of increasing utilization in India while bringing US teams back within sustainable capacity without sacrificing delivery quality.

Just as importantly, you'll lead the change required to make the framework stick. You'll evolve our framework to support Project Managers in taking greater ownership of project business outcomes. Most of the people who need to adopt the model won't report to you, so you'll use data, credibility, and influence to create consistency across teams, regions, and cultures.

The Skills You'll Have

Portfolio Governance & Delivery Management

  • Own governance across a portfolio of concurrent SaaS implementation projects, maintaining clear visibility into project health, risk, and delivery outcomes.
  • Build and operate meaningful project gates with defined entry and exit criteria that determine whether projects are truly ready to progress.
  • Establish a consistent review cadence for Yellow and Red projects that drives intervention, accountability, and measurable improvements in outcomes.
  • Use governance to challenge project reporting and surface delivery risk early enough for the organization to act. You will have executive sponsorship to change how project health is reported and reviewed.
  • Scale portfolio governance as project volume grows while maintaining delivery quality, accountability, and consistency.

Services Financial Management

  • Manage professional services financials across a portfolio, including earned value, margin, revenue forecasting, and utilization.
  • Apply earned value in practice to understand project performance and identify financial risk before it impacts results.
  • Forecast services revenue from project backlog and maintain reliable financial visibility at the individual project record level.
  • Use project-level financial data to actively steer portfolio decisions rather than simply reporting results after the fact.
  • Diagnose and defend margin variances while translating financial performance into clear actions for delivery leadership.

Delivery Methodology & Operational Framework

  • Design and implement a standardized delivery methodology spanning lifecycle phases, readiness gates, project classifications, and project planning.
  • Build repeatable project plan templates that account for different offerings and levels of implementation complexity.
  • Establish close-out reporting that captures lessons learned and feeds insights back into Product, scoping, and future delivery.
  • Roll out a delivery methodology across multiple regions and create the structure needed for consistent global adoption.
  • Turn documented methodology into an operating model teams actually use, measuring adoption and improving the framework as the organization scales.

Global Resource & Capacity Management

  • Lead capacity planning and staffing across a global services organization with both onshore and offshore delivery resources.
  • Establish utilization targets and staffing rules using system data to make informed resource allocation decisions.
  • Balance capacity across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and offshore delivery teams while protecting project quality and customer outcomes.
  • Build scalable resource management practices that increase effective use of offshore delivery capabilities as project volume grows.
  • Govern non-billable work and resource allocations to improve utilization, capacity visibility, and overall services efficiency.

Change Leadership & Influence

  • Lead operating model changes across Project Management, Delivery Management, and regional teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Navigate resistance to new governance processes while building alignment around the business outcomes behind the change.
  • Influence stakeholders through data, credibility, and a clear understanding of delivery and financial tradeoffs.
  • Build methods that can be taught and adopted across regions rather than remaining dependent on individual expertise.
  • Drive lasting behavioral change that increases PM ownership of scope, risk, customer conversations, and project business outcomes.

Within 90 Days, You'll

  • Build a clear baseline of the global delivery portfolio, including current governance practices, project data quality, financial visibility, utilization, capacity, and the most significant delivery risks.
  • Define the future-state delivery framework, including lifecycle phases, project classifications, readiness gates, ownership, and escalation expectations across AMER, EMEA, and India.
  • Establish working relationships with Project Managers, Delivery Managers, regional leadership, Finance, Product, and Operations while identifying the highest-priority changes needed to improve predictability and margin.

Within 180 Days, You'll

  • Roll out the core delivery governance framework, including meaningful readiness assessments, Yellow/Red Project Get to Green reviews, project-level financial governance, and stronger Salesforce and PSA data standards.
  • Establish repeatable project plans and governance expectations across Sitetracker's core offerings while beginning to measure adoption and address gaps across regions.
  • Implement global capacity and staffing practices that improve visibility into utilization, non-billable work, and resource allocation across US and offshore teams.

Within 365 Days, You'll

  • Establish a globally adopted Solution Delivery framework that provides consistent lifecycle governance, readiness criteria, project classification, planning, and close-out practices across regions.
  • Deliver trusted portfolio-level visibility into earned value, margin, revenue forecast, project health, capacity, and utilization, enabling leadership to make earlier and better-informed decisions.
  • Improve the scalability of the global delivery model by increasing utilization of the India Delivery Center and bringing US utilization within sustainable capacity while maintaining delivery quality.

jobs.excerpt: Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth?
jobs.description:
Want to make a positive difference to the future of people and our one shared home, the Earth? Working at WWF could be your opportunity of a lifetime.

All around the world, people are waking up to the devastating impacts of climate change and nature loss. The situation today is worse than the darkest predictions of just ten years ago, pushing billions of people to the edge and threatening lives and livelihoods. At WWF, we are facing our biggest crisis – and our biggest ever opportunity – to create a better future for people and nature. With over 60 years of experience and an active presence in more than 100 countries, we work to achieve both on-the-ground and global policy action, from protecting and restoring species and their habitats, to transforming markets and policies toward sustainability.

Our people come from hugely diverse backgrounds and with a variety of expertise, ranging from conservation science and advocacy to HR and finance. We welcome applications from anyone who believes they can help us tackle this enormous global challenge and drive the urgent conservation impact needed to restore our planet.

What We Do We are an independent conservation organization, striving to sustain the natural world for the benefit of people and the ecosystem. From individuals and communities to businesses and governments, we are part of a growing global movement calling for bolder action on climate and nature, demanding that world leaders set nature on the path to recovery by 2030. WWF works to address the most dominant drivers of nature loss through system-wide changes in how food and energy are produced and consumed, and in how financial systems are structured. By implementing change in every country, we aim to drive visible and positive impacts on the ground, helping to restore nature in the most critical places around the world, from the Amazon to the Coral Triangle.

Engaging everyone means addressing the barriers to participation faced by some groups in society, including local communities. Conservation will only be sustainable if it is owned by, and benefits, local people. That’s why Indigenous Peoples and local communities must be at the centre of action on climate and nature. WWF is committed to using its resources and global network to support these communities in creating together the most effective solutions where they live.

Humanity is still in time, we have a clear pathway to solve this crisis. At WWF, we call on everyone to join the global movement, change how we live, and take action now.

Position title: Specialist, Project Management Reports to: Special Advisor to the Director General Supervises: None. Level: 3 Contract Type: Fixed Term for 6 Months

1 MISSION OF THE DEPARTMENT

The Director General's Office unites and supports WWF International and the Network in unleashing the full potential of our federated structure through robust governance, strategic internal and external engagement, and special projects. Operating in line with WWF's Values, the Office facilitates impactful, accountable, and inclusive decision-making for WWF International and the Network's governing bodies, including the International Board, Network Executive Team, Council, Assembly, Board and NET Committees, the WWF International Executive Team, and the WWF International Senior Leadership Team. It engenders network-wide coordination and action towards WWF's priorities as set by these governing bodies; ensures the institutional arrangements and structure of the Network are sound and operating with integrity; and drives results towards the highest priorities of WWF's Director General and President.

2 MAJOR FUNCTIONS

The Project Management Officer provides temporary project management, coordination and strategic support to the Special Advisor to the Director General during a set period of time. The role ensures effective delivery across a broad portfolio of initiatives and provides dedicated support for the development of the WWF International Strategic Plan. In both capacities, the Project Management Officer will be expected to develop supporting content, including correspondence with executives, high-level presentations, and effective engagement agendas.

3 MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

A. Overarching Project Coordination and “Air Traffic Control” (30%)

  • Maintain visibility across dozens of active projects and priorities within the Director General's Office portfolio.
  • Coordinate weekly project review meetings and maintain consolidated action and decision trackers.
  • Monitor progress against agreed deadlines and proactively follow up with project owners and contributors.
  • Draft reminders, follow-up notes, and requests for information on behalf of the Special Advisor.

B. Project Management of Key Projects (50%)

  • Serve as project management support for two major efforts: the development of the WWF International Strategic Plan and a Network Working Group on Roadmap 2030.
  • Maintain the overall strategic planning workplan, timeline, milestones, dependencies, and action trackers.
  • Draft agendas and pre-meeting reading materials.

  • Ensure strategic planning documentation is organised, current, and accessible.

C. Correspondence, Engagement and Content Development/Management (15%)

  • Draft and edit correspondence, stakeholder communications, briefing notes, reports, presentations, meeting minutes, and meeting materials.
  • Coordinate collection of inputs and content from colleagues across WWF International and the broader Network.
  • Edit and quality-control executive-facing documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professionalism.
  • Support stakeholder engagement activities, including preparation of agendas, meeting materials, and follow-up communications.
  • Assist in preparing content for governance and leadership meetings, as well as summary packs for the Executive Team, Senior Leadership Team, Network Executive Team, Board Committees, and International Board as required.

D. Administrative and Data Entry Support (5%)

5 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Internal. Reporting to the Special Advisor to the Director General, works closely with colleagues in the Director General's Office, Governance & Network Engagement, Executive Team offices and project leads across WWF International. The role will engage with senior leadership, subject matter experts, and colleagues involved in strategic planning and governance-related processes.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Systems Administrator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management, monitoring, patching, security, and compliance of property-based server infrastructure and on-site technology platforms across a large, distributed environment.

You will manage virtualised workloads, server infrastructure, CCTV systems, endpoint security, backups, and related platforms, working autonomously while collaborating with Australian-based technology teams when escalation or physical intervention is required. The role is focused on maintaining high availability, security, standardisation, and operational reliability across the infrastructure estate.

About the Client

You will be working with a leading property technology and services organisation that supports a diverse national portfolio spanning residential, student accommodation, seniors living, and build-to-rent communities.

The organisation operates a large-scale technology environment across more than 130 properties, supporting tens of thousands of beds and dwellings. Its infrastructure includes virtualised server environments, CCTV platforms, endpoint security, backup systems, and other critical property technology services.

Ideal Profile

Essential Experience

  • Proven experience as a Systems Administrator or in a comparable infrastructure role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with virtualisation platforms, with Proxmox highly preferred.
  • Solid administration experience across Windows Server and Linux, including patching and security hardening.
  • Experience with RMM platforms such as NinjaOne or equivalent.
  • Experience monitoring backup platforms and conducting documented test restores.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, and firmware lifecycle management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong written English and the ability to communicate clearly with Australian-based stakeholders.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience with CCTV or VMS platforms, particularly NX Witness.
  • Experience managing distributed infrastructure across multiple sites or geographic locations.
  • Familiarity with Dell server firmware and iDRAC management.
  • Basic scripting or automation skills using Bash, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Experience with SentinelOne or comparable enterprise endpoint security platforms.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-driven, and disciplined in maintaining documentation and operational standards.
  • Proactive and detail-oriented, with the ability to identify potential infrastructure issues before they become service-impacting incidents.
  • Comfortable working remotely and autonomously, with strong ownership and accountability.
  • A clear written communicator who provides complete and actionable escalations and updates.
  • Customer-focused, particularly when supporting service desk requests.
  • Collaborative and low-ego, with respect for scope boundaries and cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Virtualisation & Hypervisor Management

  • Manage, monitor, maintain, patch, and securely configure Proxmox hypervisors across geographically distributed sites.
  • Perform controlled Proxmox upgrades and version updates in line with internal standards and testing procedures.
  • Manage applicable Dell server firmware and iDRAC updates.
  • Monitor CPU, memory, storage, cluster health, and physical server performance, proactively addressing issues and alerts.

Virtual Machine Management

  • Administer Windows Server and Linux virtual machines running across the Proxmox environment.
  • Apply patching, security baselines, configuration standards, and performance monitoring.
  • Use NinjaOne RMM for remote administration, monitoring, patching, and configuration management.
  • Identify and remediate configuration drift, performance degradation, and capacity risks.

Backup Monitoring & Recovery

  • Manage the operational monitoring of backup and disaster recovery platforms across infrastructure workloads.
  • Investigate backup failures and ensure issues are resolved promptly.
  • Conduct regular backup verification and documented test restores to validate recoverability.
  • Escalate recurring or systemic backup issues with clear technical documentation.

CCTV & Video Management

  • Manage Linux-based CCTV servers and the NX Witness VMS environment across the property portfolio.
  • Monitor operating system health, disk health, storage utilisation, RAID, SMART alerts, and hardware status.
  • Perform controlled Linux, firmware, and NX Witness updates.
  • Monitor camera connectivity, recording performance, storage capacity, and retention risks.
  • Escalate incidents requiring physical intervention with clear information for onsite support.

Endpoint Security

  • Manage SentinelOne Complete across all in-scope property-based systems.
  • Ensure endpoints remain onboarded, online, protected, and correctly configured.
  • Investigate security alerts and suspicious activity, escalating incidents in accordance with established procedures.
  • Identify and resolve gaps in endpoint protection and reporting.

Service Desk Support

  • Provide service desk coverage when required, supporting resident-facing Wi-Fi, IPTV, and in-scope technology requests.
  • Acknowledge, triage, resolve, and appropriately escalate tickets.
  • Maintain clear, professional, and accurate communication with residents and operational stakeholders.
  • Ensure tickets contain sufficient documentation to support efficient resolution and escalation.

Monitoring, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Proactively monitor infrastructure for performance degradation, capacity constraints, and security vulnerabilities.
  • Maintain accurate documentation covering system standards, patch schedules, known issues, and remediation procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, automation, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide consistent reporting on patch compliance, backup health, CCTV status, and security posture.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace

🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
