Organization Overview

Tens of millions of people in the U.S. live with chronic financial insecurity, inadequate savings, and no meaningful wealth, with deeply harmful consequences for themselves, their children, families, communities, employers, and the economy. Black, Latinx, and women-led households disproportionately experience financial insecurity due in large part to longstanding, systemic racism and gender discrimination. Addressing these issues is critical to Commonwealth's work of making wealth possible for all.

For over two decades, Commonwealth's fundamental purpose has remained to create a stronger and more prosperous society where everyone has financial opportunity. Our work has enabled over 2 million people to save nearly $8 billion on a path to greater financial security and wealth. We are now embarking on a new 4-year strategic plan that seeks greater impact and builds on our systems focus to expand workplace benefits, strengthen partnerships with financial institutions and fintech partners, and explore new frontiers like climate and generative AI.

Commonwealth strengthens the financial opportunity and security of financially vulnerable people by discovering ideas, piloting solutions, and driving innovations to scale. We understand broad change requires market players to act. That's why we take a unique approach to collaborate with consumers, the financial services industry, employers, policymakers, and mission-driven organizations. The solutions we build are grounded in real life, based on our deep understanding of people who are financially vulnerable and how businesses can best serve them.

For more than two decades, we have moved employers to prioritize worker financial security, the financial services industry to bring products to market that better serve financially vulnerable people, and policymakers to pass legislation and take action to enable savings and financial security. To learn more about the organization, please visit
buildcommonwealth.org.

Diversity of background and perspective are strengths that we value. We are committed to creating a diverse, dedicated, skilled, and collaborative environment, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Commonwealth recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected statuses.

Position Overview

Commonwealth is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager (SMM) to join our team. The role will be part of a passionate, highly cross-functional team dedicated to supporting Commonwealth's mission of creating systemic change for people living with financial insecurity. This individual will work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director, Senior Vice Presidents, Project Owners, Project Managers, and other members of the marketing team.

The SMM will serve as the marketing project lead for two or more projects and is responsible for ensuring the communications strategy and its implementation are aligned with and moving forward the overall goals of the project. Specific responsibilities include developing a marketing strategy to message and amplify specific project initiatives, creating a detailed marketing plan, and developing content such as project briefs, research reports, infographics, blog posts, and social media copy, in partnership and close collaboration with the project team(s). This individual will also work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director to ensure integration of owned content at an organizational and operational level, and to develop strategy around PR and events/conferences.

The right person for this role has a roll-up-your-sleeves, get-the-work-done mentality. This is a great opportunity for someone who can think strategically, has extensive knowledge of marketing best practices, thrives in a collaborative team, and makes decisions based on data. A best fit is someone who thrives as much in strategy planning as they do in operational execution. The SMM will project manage the communications plan execution and production implementation, ensuring timely content publication and promotion. Please join us if you are looking to contribute to a fast-paced, social impact organization.

Responsibilities

  • Support the marketing strategy, development, management, and production for two or more Commonwealth programs, ensuring that marketing goals are met and remain top of mind throughout the life of the project
  • Create project-specific marketing strategy canvases and marketing plans, including communication of KPIs in partnership with the Project Owner; continuously update the plan with new information and ensure the project team is aligned with strategies
  • Project manage and execute all aspects of the marketing plan, including content development, amplification plans, deployment strategies, and post-mortem activities; lead production management for projects and assets
  • Act as marketing contact and liaison with external partners
  • Liaise with strategic marketing team members leading events, press opportunities, social media, and newsletter
  • Write marketing copy for social media posts, newsletters, blogs, and other digital marketing assets
  • Draft grant deliverables summaries and contribute to funder trackers and reporting
  • Support partner demonstrations through contribution to research methodologies, research participant recruiting efforts, developing partner communications campaign materials, and partner engagement as needed
  • Communicate and partner with the strategic marketing team on PR and speaking opportunities
  • Actively promote continuous learning and improvement, applying marketing best practices to every project
  • Creatively problem-solve and collaborate with a small, results-oriented team to keep projects on track toward both short-term milestones and long-term strategic objectives
  • Contribute to a positive organizational culture with high optimism, appetite for learning, and eagerness to collaborate with colleagues

Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects concurrently with a high degree of organization, attention to detail, and flexibility
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to coordinate multiple project deliverables with diverse stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to meet deadlines while working collaboratively with team members
  • Functions well under pressure in a fast-paced environment

This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care.

jobs.description:
Role Overview:

We are hiring an architect to raise the design floor across engineering through trusted, practical technical direction. You’ll shape a govtech platform spanning microservices, front-end replatforming, AI products, and AI-native delivery—making the system coherent, safe, and fast to change within a FedRAMP-conscious environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Own cross-cutting technical direction: service boundaries, contracts, data architecture, and platform evolution across our decomposition and replatforming programs
  • Design in the open: architecture decision records, design reviews inside our Plan-and-Review cadence, explicit trade-offs, and written reasoning others can challenge
  • Treat dependent teams as first-class customers: gather their requirements before designing, validate against real consumers before building, and close the loop when things change
  • Raise the floor: coach tech leads through their own designs; success is more people who can architect, not more decisions routed through you
  • Keep designs as simple as the problem allows; we treat unneeded complexity as a defect, not a signal of sophistication
  • Partner with AI Operations and DevOps so architecture is enforced by the delivery system (contracts, validation, gates) rather than by memo
  • Bring architectural judgment to how AI agents design and modify systems, so machine-produced code lands inside human-owned structure

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of engineering experience, including several years driving architecture across multiple teams in SaaS or platform environments
  • A track record of designs that shipped and held up in production; we will ask what broke and what you learned
  • Real experience decomposing a monolith into services in production, with the scars to show for it
  • Fluency with AI-era architecture: agentic systems, LLM integration patterns, and designing for codebases partially produced by agents
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, HIPAA, or similar) is a strong plus
  • Exceptional written and verbal clarity; you make complex systems legible

Key Competencies

  • Comprehension before construction: you restate requirements in your own words and confirm them before you design
  • Visible uncertainty: you surface confusion early and loudly; silent guessing is the one behavior we cannot work with
  • Consumer empathy: the constraints of dependent teams are design inputs, not obstacles
  • Simplicity bias: the best design is the one the team can carry without you
  • Comfortable being wrong in public and fast to update

What This Role Is NOT

This is not an ivory-tower seat and not a gatekeeping seat. If your model of architecture is producing artifacts that other people must implement, or serving as the mandatory approval on every decision, this is not the fit. Architecture here is a service to the teams shipping, and its success is measured by how much better they design, not by how often they need you.

How We Work

We run an AI-native development lifecycle where agents help plan, build, validate, and release, while humans own judgment and direction. Our standards are simple: own and understand everything you ship, and surface uncertainty early.

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with significant employer contributions for employees AND dependents (contributions based on base-level plan; buyup plans available at additional costs)
  • Company-sponsored life/disabilities insurances
  • 11 Paid holidays
  • Flexible time off
  • 401k plan with 4% employer match
  • Monthly stipends for wellness and home office expenses

About Aegis Ventures

Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

About the Company

Avandra Imaging's mission is to unlock clinical data to overcome previously impossible medical challenges, bringing hope and medical breakthroughs that transform patient lives. Avandra is poised to revolutionize healthcare research and innovation by creating the largest indexed data cloud of medical imaging. This platform will unlock unprecedented access to real-world imaging data, essential for biopharma research, medical device innovation, AI model training, and improved patient care.

Leveraging its strategic acquisitions, Avandra aims to aggregate and de-identify vast amounts of imaging data, providing frictionless access to this invaluable resource. With a national footprint of over 5,000 customer integrations and a market share of approximately 70%, this robust infrastructure supports their core business, ensuring continued growth and cash flow to fuel their innovative data cloud platform.

About the Job

As our Growth Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for executing Avandra’s marketing strategy across digital channels, content, demand generation, and industry events. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing thought leadership, launching marketing campaigns, managing a website, coordinating conferences, and measuring marketing performance. This person will ideally have marketing experience in real-world data, healthcare technology, enterprise imaging, PACS/VNA, or a closely related healthcare market.

This role will work closely with sales, product, engineering, and executive leadership to build programs that generate qualified pipeline across both of Avandra’s businesses: Image Exchange and Real-World Imaging Data.

Role Organization

Role Title: Network Engineer Team Lead

Company Overview

At NetCov, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge IT and cybersecurity solutions designed to protect and optimize the digital infrastructure for the industries we serve. We differentiate ourselves through deep knowledge of our clients’ business and a commitment to exceptional service.

About the Role

As a senior member of the Project Services Team, the Network Engineer Team Lead architects and implements complex network infrastructures across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS), partnering with the Network Architect on solution design and review, while leading and developing the network engineering function. The role combines deep technical expertise with leadership: setting standards, mentoring engineers, and ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery.

Serving as the technical authority for all network engagements, the Team Lead is accountable for quality, documentation, and risk management, and for resolving advanced networking issues across the client base, taking projects from inception to production and end-user attestation.

Technical Responsibilities
  • Architect and implement complex on-premises, virtual, and cloud (AWS/Azure) network infrastructures, taking projects from inception through production and end-user attestation.
  • Partner with the Network Team Architect to design, review, and validate network solutions prior to implementation.
  • Troubleshoot network-impacting outages quickly and efficiently in unfamiliar environments, with minimal client impact.
  • Implement and support advanced routing (OSPF, BGP, VRRP, HSRP), L2 technologies (STP variants, 802.1x, 802.1ad), and core services (DHCP, DNS, RADIUS/NPS).
  • Design and troubleshoot VPN and tunneling technologies, including SSL/TLS, IPSEC, policy-based VPNs, and GRE.
  • Work hands-on in the CLI across Cisco, Palo Alto, SonicWall, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, and Ruckus platforms.
  • Standardize and maintain accurate documentation of client network environments before handoff to support teams.
Leadership Responsibilities
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, mentoring, and coaching to network engineers and project resources from technical oversight
  • Review network designs, implementation plans, and documentation before client delivery.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex networking challenges and lead high-visibility engagements.
  • Identify risks early, drive process improvement and automation, and partner with the Engineering, Escalations, and Service Desk teams on seamless handoffs.
  • Support the Network Team Manager with interviews and hiring of the network engineers.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required
  • Experience:3-5 years of high-level, hands-on networking experience, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Networking:Deep expertise in the TCP/IP stack, L2/L3 forwarding, advanced routing (OSPF, BGP, VRRP, HSRP), and L2 technologies (STP, 802.1x, 802.1ad).
  • Services & Security:Hands-on with DHCP, DNS, RADIUS (NPS), and VPN/tunneling (SSL/TLS, IPSEC, GRE).
  • Vendor Platforms:CLI-level experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, SonicWall, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, and Ruckus.
  • Cloud:Strong understanding of AWS and Azure networking.
  • Leadership & Communication:Proven ability to mentor engineers, set standards, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Certifications:Cisco CCNA or greater, AWS Solutions Architect, and/or Azure Network Engineer certification (or similar) preferred.

Role Logistics

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.
  • This position may require travel to clients or company offices as needed.

About Waythrough

Waythrough was formed in 2024 following the merger of Humankind and Richmond Fellowship. Together, we’ve created one of the largest mental health and social support charities in England.

Every year, we support around 125,000 people through nearly 200 services – and it’s all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.

About the Role

As External Affairs Officer, you’ll play an important role in supporting Waythrough’s external affairs, policy and campaigning activity. Working closely with the External Affairs and Strategy Specialist and senior colleagues, you’ll help us understand the changing external environment, advocate for positive change and ensure the voices of people with lived experience inform our work.

You’ll support and brief the CEO and other senior leaders on events and policy messaging, contribute to a large national campaign, write policy submissions and briefings, help organise events, work with the wider communications team to raise Waythrough’s profile and contribute to wider policy alliances and learning spaces. All of this in tireless pursuit of our new strategy The Way Ahead and goal of saving a million lives and enhancing a million more over the next decade.

Key Duties

  • Support horizon scanning and analysis of relevant policy, political and sector developments, identifying risks and opportunities.
  • Support advocacy and profile of CEO, Executive Directors and Director of Strategy and Communications through briefings, preparing articles/letters and presentations
  • Coordinate a significant national campaign focused on co-occurring mental health and drug and alcohol issues.

  • Research and prepare blogs, statements, presentations, briefings and summaries for senior leaders.

  • Respond quickly to emerging political, policy and external affairs issues.

About You

You’ll have experience working in a policy, public affairs, campaigns or similar environment, with a clear understanding of how to advocate for change. You’ll be confident researching and interpreting policy and political information and turning complex information into clear, accurate written content.

You’ll be a strong communicator and relationship builder, comfortable working with people across different teams, organisations and perspectives to achieve shared goals. You be able to brief senior colleagues and learn from our Life Experience Council of people with experience of our support services.

You’ll be able to manage competing priorities and deadlines in a busy environment while maintaining a high standard of work.

We’re particularly interested in people who understand the systems supporting people with drug and alcohol, mental health or related needs, and who have an understanding of UK politics and parliamentary processes.

  • Establish yourself as a trusted strategic advisor to clients and internal teams
  • Contribute to new business pitches with strong strategic thinking and industry expertise
  • Develop a reputation for innovative email and SMS strategies that drive real results
  • Demonstrate clear ROI from email and SMS initiatives across client accounts
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships that drive integrated client success

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Strong proficiency in Klaviyo platform including automation flow design, custom event tracking, API integrations with ecommerce platforms, behavioral segmentation, and custom metric creation
  • Working knowledge of at least one additional ESP (such as Attentive, Emarsys, Iterable, or Braze) is preferred

What's In It For Me?

SALARY RANGE

jobs.description:
About Valiantys

At Valiantys, we help organizations transform the way they work by unlocking the full potential of Atlassian solutions. As the world's leading Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner, we combine deep technical expertise, consulting excellence, and innovation to help our customers accelerate digital transformation, improve collaboration, and deliver better outcomes.

Operating across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, our teams partner with some of the world's most recognized organizations to solve complex business challenges through technology, advisory services, and managed services.

As AI continues to reshape the future of work, we are committed to integrating intelligent delivery practices that enable our teams and customers to work smarter, make better decisions, and deliver greater value.

Job Summary

    The Principal Solution Consultant is a senior solution consulting and methodology leader responsible for shaping complex, outcome-driven consulting engagements. The role leads complex consulting framing, executive-level discovery, outcome architecture, governance design, and practice quality where greater ambiguity management, stakeholder alignment, and advisory rigor are required.

    Sitting above the Senior Solution Consultant role, the position focuses on complex or multi-domain engagements, methodology quality, and coaching across the practice. It owns the consulting narrative and advisory quality, while Engagement Directors own broader executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, strategic escalation, and account-level value realization. Technical architecture, integration patterns, scalability, and detailed platform design remain owned by Technical Architects.

What you'll do

    As a Senior Project Manager, you will:

    • Lead complex solution consulting engagements where business intent, operating model, value case, governance, and delivery approach need to be clarified.
    • Provide executive-level discovery and advisory leadership without owning account commercials, pricing, close plans, or portfolio strategy.
    • Shape business and operating-model architecture without owning detailed technical architecture, integrations, data flows, or platform standards.
    • Raise solution consulting quality through methodology stewardship, stage-gate discipline, artifact quality, and coaching.

      • Responsibilities

      Complex Consulting Framing and Executive Discovery

      • Lead executive-level discovery to clarify business intent, transformation constraints, value targets, operating model impacts, risks, and success measures.
      • Translate ambiguous business problems into structured consulting narratives, decision paths, phased approaches, and measurable outcome models.
      • Frame current-state and future-state narratives connecting people, process, technology, governance, adoption, and value realization.
      • Guide senior stakeholders toward decision-ready recommendations grounded in feasible delivery and customer maturity.

        • Outcome Architecture and Governance Design

        • Define outcome architecture, including value hypotheses, KPI models, baseline measures, target outcomes, and benefits tracking.
        • Design governance models appropriate to engagement complexity, including stage gates, decision forums, escalation paths, and executive readout cadence.
        • Establish consulting guardrails for scope, assumptions, risk posture, adoption needs, success measures, and decision ownership.
        • Ensure major phases have clear evidence, decision points, and artifacts supporting alignment and accountability.

          • Strategic Advisory Focus

          • Help customers improve how work is governed across teams, departments, programs, and portfolios.
          • Advise executives on organizational structures that improve accountability, visibility, and strategic alignment.
          • Recommend portfolio management approaches balancing investment, capacity, priorities, and business outcomes.
          • Guide customers in defining measurable goals, OKRs, reporting frameworks, and executive dashboards.
          • Translate organizational strategy into scalable work management solutions supported by Atlassian products.
          • Serve as a trusted advisor focused on business challenges, not simply software implementation.

            • Methodology and Stage-Gate Advisory

            • Apply and evolve the Solution Consulting methodology while tailoring it to client context without losing rigor or consistency.
            • Guide teams through stage-gate advisory practices across diagnosis, design and planning, validation, activation, and scale.
            • Review key engagement artifacts for clarity, completeness, value alignment, and readiness for customer or executive review.
            • Identify gaps in advisory quality, governance, requirements clarity, adoption planning, or outcome measurement and help teams resolve them early.

              • Complex Deal Advisory and Scoping Support

              • Support complex pursuits through discovery approach, advisory workshops, solution framing, scope assumptions, value case, and delivery risk.
              • Provide consulting input to proposals and SOWs where business outcomes, governance, operating model, roadmap, or methodology require stronger definition.
              • Partner with Sales and Account teams as an advisory and scoping contributor without owning pursuit strategy, commercial strategy, pricing, negotiation, or close plan.
              • Identify where additional input is required from Engagement Directors, Principal Solution Architects, Technical Architects, or delivery leadership.

                • Artifact Ownership and Advisory Quality

                • Create or review consulting artifacts including value cases, current-state and future-state narratives, operating models, phased roadmaps, governance models, KPI models, benefits trackers, decision logs, and executive readouts.
                • Ensure artifacts are decision-ready, logically connected, customer-specific, and usable by delivery teams and senior stakeholders.
                • Convert field lessons into reusable playbooks, templates, accelerators, discovery guides, workshop formats, and quality standards.
                • Maintain a high bar for clarity, evidence, traceability, and measurable value.

                  • Coaching, Practice Quality, and Team Leadership

                  • Coach Senior Solution Consultants and Solution Consultants through structured feedback, advisory review, workshop preparation, and artifact improvement.
                  • Lead by example on executive communication, consulting structure, facilitation, value framing, and artifact clarity.
                  • Support hiring, onboarding, enablement, communities of practice, and internal quality reviews.
                  • Contribute to mentoring, capability planning, practice standards, and consulting talent development.
                  • Model responsible use of approved AI tools to improve delivery efficiency, speed, quality, consistency, and value realization.

                    • Decision Rights and Collaboration

                    • The Principal Solution Consultant owns complex consulting framing, outcome architecture, methodology quality, stage-gate advisory, and coaching.
                    • Senior Solution Consultants own solution design intent and customer-facing advisory on standard and medium-complexity engagements.
                    • Principal Solution Architects and Technical Architects own technical architecture, integration patterns, scalability, platform design, and detailed technical feasibility.
                    • Engagement Directors own executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, strategic escalation, and account-level value realization.
                    • Sales owns account and commercial strategy, pricing, negotiation, close plan, and deal progression.

                      • Skills and Experience

                      Required Qualifications

                      • Proven experience in solution consulting, management consulting, business transformation, enterprise PMO, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), or related advisory roles.
                      • Proven ownership of large or complex consulting engagements with multiple stakeholders, workstreams, phases, or business domains.
                      • Experience designing enterprise work management solutions using Atlassian products including Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence. Experience with Jira Align, Atlassian Focus, or Atlassian Strategy Collection is highly desirable.
                      • Demonstrated experience leading executive-level discovery, advisory workshops, governance forums, and decision-oriented client conversations.
                      • Strong capability in problem framing, value modeling, KPI definition, roadmapping, operating model design, adoption planning, and benefits tracking.
                      • Strong understanding of project, program, and portfolio management principles, including governance models, work hierarchies, dependencies, roadmaps, and executive reporting.
                      • Fluency in stage-gate governance, iterative delivery, consulting methodology, and outcome-based advisory practices.
                      • Strong familiarity with enterprise delivery, ITSM, Agile, Work Management, service management, and adjacent Atlassian ecosystem considerations.
                      • Ability to coach consultants, review advisory artifacts, and raise delivery quality through repeatable methods and reusable assets.

                        • Preferred Qualifications

                        • Experience in regulated, complex, or enterprise environments such as financial services, healthcare, automotive, public sector, or global organizations.
                        • Knowledge of ITIL, SAFe, Lean-Agile, DevOps, Enterprise Service Management, change management, or operating model frameworks.
                        • Certifications such as Atlassian ACP, SAFe SPC or SAFe Lean Portfolio Management (LPM), PMP, PMI-PfMP, PMI-PgMP, or equivalent consulting certifications.
                        • Experience contributing to practice development, team leadership, hiring, onboarding, enablement, or consulting quality programs.

                          • Governance leadership: defines cadence, stage gates, decision forums, escalation paths, and evidence needs.
                          • Systems thinking: connects people, process, technology, governance, risk, and operating model considerations.
                          • Talent multiplier: raises the bar through coaching, quality review, reusable assets, and team leadership.

                            • Career Path and Growth Options

                            This role is part of the Solution Consulting Practice and provides multiple growth paths depending on strengths, business need, and leadership interests:

                            • Engagement Director: owning broader executive relationships, portfolio outcomes, and account-level value realization.
                            • Practice Lead or Team Leadership: owning consulting capability development, standards, enablement, and people leadership.
                            • Head of Solutions Consulting or similar senior leadership role: owning practice strategy, quality, and cross-functional alignment.

Why join Valiantys?

    At Valiantys, you'll join an international team of passionate experts who are shaping the future of digital collaboration.

What we offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package

Our client is a US-based behavioral health and substance use treatment provider delivering care across the full continuum — Detox, Residential, Partial Hospitalization (PHP), Intensive Outpatient (IOP), and Outpatient (OP). Treatment cannot start without financial clearance, and financial clearance starts with you. As the Verification of Benefits (VOB) Specialist, you sit at the intersection of admissions, billing, and clinical operations, owning the verification workflow that determines whether a client is covered, what level of care their plan supports, and what authorizations are required before care begins.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role for a detail-driven insurance professional who can move quickly without sacrificing accuracy. You will run VOBs end-to-end, document them in the client's EMR face sheet, and translate complex commercial and government benefit structures into clear, actionable summaries for the teams who rely on them. Twice a month — on the 1st and the 16th — you will re-verify every active client policy to catch lapses, terminations, or coverage changes before they disrupt treatment. You will also track COBRA and Marketplace premium payments, where a missed payment can quietly end coverage mid-treatment.

Within 90 days you will be the team's trusted source of truth for insurance status. Within 6 months you will have visibility into face-sheet auditing, basic billing entry, and eligibility-driven claim follow-ups during low-volume periods — building you into a more versatile revenue cycle contributor over time.

Responsibilities

  • Perform timely and accurate verification of benefits (VOBs) for all incoming clients across Detox, Residential, PHP, IOP, and OP levels of care
  • Confirm coverage, benefit limitations, co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket maximums, exclusions, and pre-authorization requirements with each payer
  • Input VOB findings into designated tracking systems and update the client's EMR face sheet with complete supporting documentation
  • Communicate verified benefits clearly and promptly to admissions, billing, and clinical teams to enable smooth intake and continuous care coordination
  • Conduct bi-weekly re-verification of all active client insurance policies on the 1st and the 16th of every month, identifying and addressing changes, lapses, or terminations
  • Monitor and track COBRA and Marketplace premium payments for active clients on those coverage types, communicating any lapses or pending payments that may affect continued coverage
  • Maintain clear documentation of premium statuses and any outreach or action taken with clients or internal teams
  • Audit client EMR face sheets for accurate and complete insurance information during lower-volume periods
  • Enter client admission and discharge data into the billing system when the Hybrid Billing Coordinator is unavailable or at capacity
  • Assist with initial claim follow-ups for basic eligibility denials or coverage mismatches as needed
  • Upload VOB documentation to the client's EMR face sheet in collaboration with the Hybrid Billing/VOB Specialist
  • Complete special assignments and other duties as requested by the supervisor
  • Maintain HIPAA compliance and protect patient confidentiality at every step of the workflow

Requirements

Requirements

  • Prior hands-on experience with insurance verification of benefits in a US healthcare setting
  • Strong working knowledge of US commercial insurance (BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, UHC, Humana) and government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, Tricare) including pre-authorization processes
  • Direct experience using an EMR system to update face sheets and document insurance information
  • Familiarity with COBRA continuation coverage and Affordable Care Act Marketplace plans, and how premium payment status affects active coverage
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to spot missing or contradictory benefit information
  • Effective verbal and written English communication, including comfort on phone calls with US payers and async written handoffs to internal teams
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize a daily queue, and meet turnaround expectations in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated HIPAA awareness and respect for patient confidentiality
  • Reliable home internet, a quiet remote work environment, and willingness to overlap with US Mountain Time business hours

Nice to Have

  • VOB experience specifically in behavioral health, mental health, or substance use treatment settings
  • Working knowledge of behavioral health benefit structures (parity, level-of-care criteria, concurrent review) and pre-authorization for SUD/MH services
  • Experience with healthcare billing systems and initial claim follow-up on eligibility-based denials

Benefits

What We Offer

  • 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based behavioral health team
  • USD $6/hour compensation
  • Defined ownership of the VOB workflow and a clear path into broader revenue cycle responsibilities
  • A team that values accuracy, async clarity, and people who close the loop without being chased

Data Privacy

By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.

Interview Scheduling

Initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time (MST), scheduled within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window. We genuinely appreciate applicants' flexibility around the time difference.

jobs.title: Senior Workforce Analyst
jobs.excerpt: This role is built for someone who knows how to run workforce planning as a discipline—not just report on it.
jobs.description:
This role is built for someone who knows how to run workforce planning as a discipline—not just report on it. We are looking for a seasoned workforce analyst who can build and own the models that drive hiring, coverage, effecti9ve client engagement, and organizational design decisions while staying aligned to real-time executive priorities.

This individual will sit at the center of workforce strategy to translate business demand, pipeline movement, and personnel changes into clear, actionable hiring and resourcing decisions. The proper candidate must be able to operate at executive speed, providing timely updates on hiring progress, pipeline health, and risks tied to attrition or performance.

The right candidate will recognize this is a role for someone who has built workforce models before and knows how to translate their analysis into effective decisions.

Essential Job Responsibilities Include:

  • Strategic Workforce Modeling & Planning
    • Build and continuously refine workforce models that align capacity with business demand drivers (sales pipeline, renewals, account segmentation, and account complexity).
    • Develop and maintain a group and individual-level capacity model for Strategic Account Executives (SAEs) that accounts for variability in workload, tenure, and performance.
    • Create and evolve an account complexity framework (client size, program mix, broker dynamics, service requirements, etc.) and translate that into differentiated capacity assumptions.
    • Move beyond “accounts per individual” thinking to a weighted capacity model, where more complex clients appropriately consume more capacity.
    • Translate forecasted new business, client changes, and expected retention churn into forward-looking hiring and coverage plans based on true capacity—not averages.
    • Develop scenario-based models to guide leadership decisions on headcount, timing of hires, and organizational structure as client base grows.
  • Executive Visibility & Real-Time Updates
    • Serve as the single source of truth for workforce planning updates to senior leadership.
    • Maintain a real-time view of open roles, candidate pipeline status, and hiring progress.
    • Provide frequent, clear updates on:
      • Hiring pipeline health and velocity.
      • Role prioritization and sequencing.
      • At-risk personnel (performance, attrition risk, transitions) and associated backfill/capacity needs.
    • Ensure leadership always has a current, accurate picture of workforce supply vs. demand.
  • Hiring Strategy & Pipeline Management Support
    • Support HR and leadership to translate workforce plans into hiring action.
    • Support tracking and management of the hiring pipeline across roles—from req approval through offer acceptance via model and capacity insights.
    • Support Account Management leadership to align candidate prioritization to the highest-impact gaps identified through workforce modeling.
  • Workforce Insights & Decision Support
    • Own workforce dashboards that provide visibility into capacity at the individual SAE level, including over/under-utilization.
    • Highlight where account complexity creates strain or inefficiency within current team structure.
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready insights that inform decisions on hiring, backfills, account assignments, and segmentation.
    • Proactively identify risks tied to uneven workload distribution, turnover, or demand shifts.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership
    • As a key contributor of the support Revenue Operations provides, you will partner with HR, Finance, and business leaders to ensure alignment on workforce assumptions and decisions.
    • Ensure workforce data is consistent, accurate, and reflected across systems and reporting.
    • Support, where needed, alignment between workforce planning, compensation structures, and operational execution.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You have developed a workforce planning model that reflects true capacity and complexity, not ratios.
  • Leadership has real-time visibility into individual SAE capacity and where pressure exists.
  • Hiring decisions are proactive and tied to modeled demand—not reactive gaps.
  • Account assignments feel balanced because complexity is accounted for, not assumed.
  • Risks tied to attrition, performance, or uneven workload are identified early and addressed.

Why This Role Matters:

This role ensures we are not treating all accounts—or all capacity—the same. It introduces the rigor needed to align the right resources to the right work, scale intelligently, and make workforce decisions with confidence.

Required Skills / Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience of proven, effective workforce planning models, capacity planning, and workforce analytics in a mid to enterprise-sized organization..
  • Demonstrated experience building capacity models that account for variability (not averages).
  • Experience modeling workload at an individual contributor level (ideally in AM, SAE, or similar roles).
  • Strong, demonstratable analytical skills with the ability to translate complex inputs into practical decisions.
  • Experience supporting hiring planning and pipeline management processes.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and executive visibility.
  • Strong communication skills—can confidently translate data into clear, actionable leadership updates.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Account Management environments.
  • Familiarity with portfolio-based roles where account complexity drives workload models.
  • Experience building segmentation, coverage, or capacity models for client-facing teams.

Based on relevant market data and other factors, the anticipated hiring range for this role is $88,000 to $110,000 annually. Final compensation rates will be determined based on various factors, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, and internal equity considerations. This role is also short-term incentive eligible. Incentive amounts will vary by individual and business goals.

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The final salary offered to the selected candidate may vary from the posted range due to individual qualifications. Our goal is to ensure that all teammates are compensated fairly and competitively based on their contributions to our organization.

RxBenefits is also committed to providing best in class benefits to our teammates. We offer a robust total rewards package that includes:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Choice of a HDHP or PPO Medical plan, we pay 100% of the premium for the HDHP for you and your eligible family members
  • Dental, Vision, Short- and Long-Term Disability, and Group Life Insurance that we also pay 100% of premiums (for your family too on Dental and Vision)
  • Additional buy-up options for Short- and Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) with an employer match up to 3.5% available after 60 days
  • Community Service Day to give back and support what you love in your community
  • 10 company holidays including MLK Day, Juneteenth, and the day after Thanksgiving plus a floating holiday to use as you like
  • Reimbursements for high-speed internet, we’ll send you a computer and monitors to help you do your best work
  • Tuition Reimbursement for accredited degree programs
  • Paid New Parent Leave that can be used for adoption or birth
  • Pet insurance to protect your furbabies
  • A robust mental health benefit and EAP service through Spring Health to support you when you need it most

While this role does not set channel strategy or develop media plans, it plays a critical role in pressure-testing feasibility, surfacing risks, and ensuring delivery meets agreed-upon service levels and client expectations. Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Reporting (Software Engineer III)
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team that owns our enterprise reporting platform — the system responsible for delivering actionable data and insights across our dealer network. You'll work across the full stack, building the infrastructure and experiences that power the reporting our customers and internal teams rely on to make business decisions.
This is a hands-on engineering role with real ownership. You'll have the opportunity to shape how parts of the platform are built from the ground up, making meaningful architectural and technical decisions that influence how the system evolves. You'll own features end-to-end — from database schema and API design through to the UI that internal teams and dealers interact with.
You'll tackle challenges around data reliability, query performance, and scalability — problems where good engineering decisions have measurable business impact. You'll collaborate closely with product, data, and other engineering teams. We're a remote-first team that values clear communication, pragmatic technical decisions, and shipping work that matters.

Here is more of what you'll get to do:

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across our enterprise reporting platform
  • Work on systems that handle large-scale data processing — ingestion pipelines, query optimization, scheduling, and result delivery
  • Build and improve APIs, background services, and data pipelines in .NET
  • Develop and maintain cloud-native services in AWS
  • Collaborate with product and stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-architected solutions
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and incident response
  • Balance new feature development with incremental improvements to system reliability, maintainability, and developer experience
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience
  • Full-stack development — comfortable owning features from backend to frontend
  • C# / .NET — strong experience building APIs, services, and backend systems
  • AWS — hands-on experience with AWS services in production
  • SQL — strong experience writing performant queries, designing schemas, and working with relational databases
  • Solid fundamentals — distributed systems thinking, API design, testing practices, CI/CD
  • React — experience building modern frontend applications
  • Must be fluent in English and Spanish.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a mixed mode (onsite, remote or hybrid) environment, including consistent use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, and proactive communication practices while maintaining a professional on-camera presence.
Nice to have:
  • Digital marketing domain knowledge — understanding of campaign management, lead generation, or dealer/automotive marketing
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and message queue systems
  • Experience working in a multi-tenant SaaS environment
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools or BI reporting concepts

Dans ce rôle hybride, orienté vers le client, vous serez le premier point de contact pour les prospects avant de les qualifier et de les transférer à un conseiller hypothécaire nesto.

jobs.excerpt: About Tailscale Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are.
jobs.description:
About Tailscale

Tailscale is building the new Internet by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

Tailscale is redefining secure networking by making it simple for organizations to securely connect people, devices, and workloads anywhere in the world.

At Tailscale, we're solving one of the most fundamental challenges in modern infrastructure: secure connectivity. Our product is loved by developers, trusted by IT and security teams, and rapidly expanding within organizations of every size. As adoption accelerates, we are investing in a regional sales motion that matches the scale of our ambition across EMEA.

We are looking for a founding Sales Director, EMEA to build and lead one of Tailscale's most important growth initiatives. This is a rare opportunity to shape how a category-leading company enters and scales a major region, develops strategic customer and partner relationships, recruits an exceptional team, and creates the operating model for long-term growth.

About the Role

You will be a regional leader, seller, coach, and builder. You will own the EMEA sales strategy and lead teams across multiple customer segments, while personally helping advance the region's most important opportunities and executive relationships.

You will define regional priorities, territory and segment strategy, hiring plans, outbound and expansion motions, and the operating cadence for the business. You will also help spearhead partnerships across the region, including channel, cloud, technology, and strategic alliance relationships that can accelerate customer acquisition and expansion.

Initially, you will lead a focused team of Account Executives across multiple segments and work closely with Customer Engineering, RevOps, Marketing, GTM Engineering, and Executive Leadership. As the business grows, you will play a central role in scaling the team, developing frontline leaders, and building the regional organization.

This UK-based role reports directly to the President and offers the opportunity to build Tailscale’s EMEA sales organization from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

Build the EMEA Business

  • Lead the current team and build the EMEA sales organization and go-to-market motion.
  • Develop the regional strategy, operating model, territory design, account segmentation, and coverage plan across multiple sales segments.
  • Set clear regional priorities and translate company goals into executable plans for new business, expansion, and partnerships.
  • Establish repeatable playbooks that reflect the needs of customers and markets across the UK and broader EMEA region.
  • Provide regional market insight that helps shape company strategy, product priorities, and investment decisions.

Lead From the Front

  • Personally support and, when appropriate, lead Tailscale's highest-value and most strategic EMEA opportunities.
  • Develop trusted executive relationships with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, infrastructure leaders, security leaders, and business executives.
  • Serve as the regional executive sponsor and quarterback for complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Coach teams on discovery, qualification, account strategy, executive engagement, negotiation, and deal execution.
  • Navigate technical, commercial, legal, procurement, and executive stakeholders to drive successful customer outcomes.

Lead and Scale Multiple Segments

  • Lead Account Executives serving multiple customer segments, from commercial and mid-market organizations through enterprise and accounts.
  • Create differentiated motions, coverage models, and performance expectations appropriate to each segment.
  • Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop exceptional sales talent across the region.
  • Build a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, curiosity, customer value, and continuous learning.
  • Develop future leaders and create the management structure required as the EMEA organization scales.

Build Regional Partnerships

  • Help define and execute the EMEA partnership strategy alongside the Partnerships organization and Executive Leadership.
  • Identify markets and customer segments where partners can accelerate awareness, pipeline creation, implementation, and expansion.
  • Create clear rules of engagement, joint account plans, and co-selling motions with priority partners.
  • Represent Tailscale with senior partner executives and at relevant regional customer and industry events.

Create Pipeline and Regional Awareness

  • Lead an outbound-first and account-based sales motion across the region.
  • Personally build executive relationships within high-priority accounts and partner ecosystems.
  • Partner with SDRs, Marketing, GTM Engineering and Partnerships to create qualified pipeline.
  • Build scalable account planning, prospecting, event, community, and partner-sourced pipeline programs.
  • Ensure the region develops a balanced pipeline across customer segments, products, countries, and sources.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Own regional forecasting, pipeline health, hiring plans, and performance management.
  • Establish a rigorous operating cadence across forecast reviews, pipeline creation, deal inspection, account planning, and talent development.
  • Use data to identify trends, improve execution, allocate resources, and communicate regional performance to leadership.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to provide structured customer and market feedback from EMEA.
  • Build the metrics, processes, and cross-functional relationships required to scale the organization effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • An experienced sales leader who has built or materially scaled a high-growth SaaS business in EMEA.
  • A proven leader of teams spanning multiple customer segments, with the judgment to adapt the sales motion by segment and market.
  • A builder who is comfortable operating with ambiguity, limited infrastructure, and significant ownership.
  • A strong seller and coach with a consistent record of winning complex new-business and expansion opportunities.
  • Experienced in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing Account Executives and sales leaders.
  • Demonstrated success building outbound pipeline and establishing repeatable regional go-to-market motions.
  • Experienced developing channel, technology, cloud, reseller, or strategic partnership relationships in EMEA.
  • Executive presence and credibility with CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and senior business leaders.
  • Strong business acumen and experience navigating complex buying committees, procurement processes, and enterprise sales cycles.
  • Deep familiarity with the UK and broader EMEA technology market; additional European language skills are valuable but not required.
  • Based in the United Kingdom and able to travel throughout EMEA as needed.

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • Want to build a region rather than inherit a mature organization.
  • Enjoy leading from the front while creating leverage through managers, teams, and partners.
  • Can balance strategic planning with hands-on customer and deal leadership.
  • Are energized by developing different sales motions for commercial, mid-market, enterprise, and strategic customers.
  • See partnerships as a core growth lever rather than a separate or secondary function.
  • Want to leave a lasting impact on how a category-leading company expands internationally.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).

  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.

We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.

FRENCH TO FOLLOW

Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee (TUEC) Member

Sport Integrity Canada is seeking individuals to fill the volunteer opportunity of Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee (TUEC) Member on an ongoing volunteer basis. The TUEC has a key role in implementing the Canadian Anti-Doping Program (CADP) by reviewing and evaluating athletes’ applications for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (TUE), which allow an athlete with a medical condition to use substances or methods that are otherwise prohibited in sport through their inclusion on the World Anti-Doping Agency’s (WADA) Prohibited List. The TUEC follows WADA’s International Standard for Therapeutic Use Exemptions (ISTUE) to determine if a TUE should be granted.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Therapeutic Use Exemption Committee Member

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Applications: Evaluate and make determinations on TUE applications from athletes, ensuring adherence to the ISTUE and its guidelines, as appropriate.
  • Decision Making: Use professional judgement to provide unbiased opinions and make impartial decisions in the best interest of athletes, sport, and the organization.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with fellow TUEC members and liaise effectively with other stakeholders.
  • Adherence: Uphold Sport Integrity Canada values, principles, and policies while maintaining confidentiality and following technical procedures as per the ISTUE.

Required Qualifications:

  • Medical Degree: M.D. or equivalent qualification.
  • Professional Experience: Demonstrated experience in sport medicine or related fields.
  • Expertise: Specialists in psychiatry (ADHD/ADD), pain management, cardiology, or general sports medicine.
  • Integrity: Impeccable ethical standards and confidentiality

  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are required; French language skills are an asset.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyze complex cases and apply logical reasoning.
  • Detail Oriented: Ability to follow protocols and procedures with precision.
  • Confidentiality: Proven track record of managing sensitive information with discretion

Membre du Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (CAUT)

Sport Intégrité Canada est à la recherche de personnes désireuses de se joindre, à titre bénévole et sur une base continue, à son Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (CAUT).

Le CAUT contribue au Programme canadien antidopage (PCA) en traitant les demandes d’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (AUT), soumises par les athlètes dont l’état de santé nécessite l’utilisation de substances ou de méthodes figurant sur la Liste des interdictions de l’Agence mondiale antidopage (AMA). Le CAUT base ses décisions sur le Standard international pour les autorisations d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques (SIAUT) de l’AMA. Sport Intégrité Canada travaille de façon collaborative afin que les Canadiens vivent des expériences sportives positives. Par ses programmes, le CCES s’attaque aux problèmes d’éthique dans le sport, protège l’intégrité du sport canadien et fait la promotion de Sport pur pour activer le sport axé sur des valeurs, sur le terrain et à l’extérieur. Sport Intégrité Canada est l’organisme national indépendant et à but non lucratif responsable de l’administration du PCA.

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Membre du Comité pour l’autorisation d’usage à des fins thérapeutiques

DÉTAILS DU POSTE

Responsabilités principales

  • Analyse des demandes : évaluer les demandes d’AUT des athlètes conformément au SIAUT et à ses lignes directrices.
  • Prise de décisions : juger les demandes d’AUT de manière avisée, professionnelle et impartiale, le tout dans l’intérêt des athlètes, du sport et de l’organisme.
  • Collaboration : travailler de concert avec les autres membres du CAUT et communiquer efficacement avec les intervenants.
  • Conformité : observer les valeurs, principes et politiques du Sport Intégrité Canada tout en maintenant la confidentialité et en suivant la procédure technique prévue par le SIAUT.

PROFIL

Exigences

  • Diplôme en médecine : M.D. ou formation équivalente.
  • Expérience professionnelle : expérience avérée en médecine sportive ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Expertise : psychiatrie (TDAH/TDA), gestion de la douleur, cardiologie ou médecine sportive générale.
  • Intégrité : rigueur éthique et confidentialité irréprochables.

Compétences

  • Communication : excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite en anglais (en français, un atout).
  • Raisonnement analytique : capacité à analyser des cas complexes selon un raisonnement logique.
  • Souci du détail : suivre les protocoles et procédures à la lettre.
  • Confidentialité : capacité éprouvée à gérer de l’information sensible avec discrétion.

DÉTAILS DU POSTE

Engagement : traiter entre deux et trois demandes d’AUT par mois (la charge de travail peut varier selon le nombre et la particularité des demandes reçues).

Réunions : participer aux réunions semestrielles (virtuelles ou en personne) du CAUT.

Lieu : télétravail.

Job Description:

Job Title: Director/Senior Director, FSAAS Sales

FSAAS: “Financial Services and Auto Adjacent Solutions”

Location: North America - Remote

The Role:  

The Director/Senior Director, FSAAS Sales is a senior individual contributor responsible for driving new business bookings and expanding strategic customer relationships within the FSAAS business. This role leads complex, consultative sales engagements and positions JD Power’s full portfolio of data, analytics, and advisory solutions with senior client stakeholders.

This position is suited for experienced, self‑directed sellers who can independently manage large, complex sales cycles while contributing market insight and field perspective to the broader sales organization.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role: 

As a Director/Senior Director, FSAAS Sales, you will play a critical role in driving bookings growth and strengthening JD Power’s presence with strategic customers and new logos. Your ability to navigate complex buying environments and engage senior decision‑makers will directly impact bookings, revenue, and long‑term account expansion across the FSAAS portfolio.

What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:

Prospecting and New Business Bookings

  • Own and execute new business bookings efforts aligned to FSAAS growth priorities.
  • Drive outbound prospecting and opportunity creation within assigned industries or accounts, with a particular focus on positioning JD Power’s Auto Valuation Portfolio.
  • Drive new business growth for JD Power’s industry-leading automotive valuation solutions—including Used Car Guide, ALG (Auto Lease Guide), and specialty vehicle values—delivering accurate, unbiased pricing and market intelligence to financial services and automotive customers.
  • Position data-driven valuation and residual solutions that enable clients to assess current and future vehicle values, optimize portfolio risk, and improve lending, leasing, and underwriting decisions.
  • Lead complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and decision‑makers.
  • Represent JD Power in executive‑level meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Account Growth

  • Expand a portfolio of strategic or high‑value accounts.
  • Build and maintain relationships with VP‑, SVP‑, and C‑level client stakeholders.
  • Develop account strategies aligned to customer objectives and JD Power capabilities.
  • Identify and advance cross‑sell, upsell, and expansion opportunities.

Bookings & Pipeline Management

  • Achieve or exceed assigned bookings targets.
  • Maintain a robust, accurate, and well‑qualified pipeline.
  • Forecast revenue reliably and manage deal progression with discipline.
  • Lead expansion and contract negotiation efforts for assigned accounts.
  • Support renewals and expansions in coordination with Customer Success.

Cross‑Functional Engagement & Market Insight

  • Partner with Customer Solutions, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to advance opportunities.
  • Provide thoughtful feedback from customers and the market to inform strategy and offerings.
  • Support development of executive‑level proposals, presentations, and value narratives.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, customer priorities, and competitive dynamics.

Metrics & Measures of Success

  • Achievement of individual bookings targets.
  • Size, health, and conversion of opportunity pipeline.
  • Strength of executive‑level customer relationships.
  • Account expansion and long‑term value creation.
  • New logo engagement and development.
  • Effectiveness of collaboration and deal execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise, consultative B2B sales.
  • Proven success selling data‑driven, SaaS, analytics, research, or advisory solutions.
  • Strong executive‑level communication and negotiation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex sales environments independently.
  • High degree of accountability, organization, and sales discipline.
  • Up to 30% travel; reside reasonable proximity to an airport

The Hiring Manager says: 

I’m looking for a seasoned seller who takes pride in running complex sales cycles, engaging senior executives, and owning meaningful bookings outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who wants to work independently, identify strategic opportunities, and sell high‑impact, consultative solutions to sophisticated clients. If you’re self‑directed, commercially sharp, and motivated by both results and long‑term account growth, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact within the FSAAS business.

This position has a starting salary range of $140,000 – $155,000 USD per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Company Mission

Our mission in the market we serve is clear. To power every auto-related decision through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and seamless workflows that connect insight to action.

Our Values

We POWER Our Customer's Success

We are Innovative, Collaborative and Grounded in Data

We Make Things Easy

We Get It Done

We Start with Trust & Prove it Everyday

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Search Experience Specialist, you will begin to own search experience strategies and workflow for your own clients A-Z. You will be responsible for the SEO, GEO/AEO and content strategy and execution of the workflow to help achieve your client’s goals. In addition to driving the strategy, you are also responsible for managing your workflow and the on-time delivery of those deliverables. From keyword research to content optimizations, you will master the execution and presentation of the core SEO, GEO and Content deliverables. Some of the daily tasks include: optimizing content, doing keyword research, assigning deliverables out to deliverable support resources, completing monthly reports, updating internal and external tracking documents, attending internal team calls and external calls with clients, and actively communicating with your account teams. The Search Experience Specialist is a fast learner and a team player who is eager to grow their craft and make a real impact for clients. As you build fluency with Claude and Power Digital's nova ecosystem, AI becomes your default way to speed up keyword research, first-draft reporting, and QA — freeing up time to focus on learning the craft and building client relationships, not replacing your judgment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute core SEO, GEO, and content deliverables on time and at a high level of accuracy, with sufficient QA to prevent revenue-impacting errors
  • Conduct keyword research, build and maintain keyword mapping and content clusters, and align topic selection to client business goals and qualified traffic opportunities
  • Assign deliverables to appropriate support resources and review returned work for quality, accuracy, and brand voice alignment
  • Flag patterns, anomalies, or early warning signs noticed during day-to-day execution to the strategist or AD, even when not specifically asked
  • Complete monthly and quarterly reports with minimal feedback, clearly connecting organic search efforts to client business goals and KPI performance
  • Develop a foundational understanding of GEO/AEO concepts and AI search behaviors, and begin incorporating that awareness into strategy and client communication
  • Communicate proactively with account teams and clients, flagging updates, questions, and relevant changes in a timely and professional manner
  • Support execution of the team's search testing roadmap, documenting test results clearly so the senior strategist can build on them
  • Begin building fluency in the client's specific vertical (e.g., B2B, Fashion, CPG) growth patterns rather than treating every account the same
  • Keep deliverable status and QA notes visible in Asana/nova so a strategist or AD can check progress without needing to ask
  • Sign up for Strategy Syncs with the organic search strategy team when a fresh perspective is needed or when an account is in escalation
  • Leverage the Nova ecosystem, AI technologies, and Power Digital workflows (Asana, Slack, novaPulse, Google Drive) to manage workflow and support execution
  • Power Circuit completion and adoption across all assigned accounts
  • Adoption and completion of Omega R&Rs for your role
  • 100% on-time delivery of assigned deliverables and launches, tracked via Asana due dates

Role Requirements:

  • Previous experience in an organic search role (internship or other). Client-facing experience is a plus
  • Basic to foundational understanding of search experience (SEO and GEO) including: on-page, technical, and off-page and how they connect to business goals
  • Familiarity with SEO, GEO and analytics tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, GA4, Profound and Screaming Frog
  • Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables across client accounts
  • Fast learner with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a cooperative team-player attitude
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, both internally and in client-facing settings
  • Comfort using Claude or comparable AI tools as part of daily workflow, with an eagerness to build fluency quickly if not there yet

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Client Book Revenue per Employee: $30k
  • Client Retention Rate: 90%
  • Range of the number of accounts (10-13)
  • Team Retention (of DRs if applicable): 90%

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Organic Search and GEO production work and strategy to help maintain strategic relationships with organic search clients
  • Tailoring strategies, and thus deliverables that are tied to client goals and being able to explain why you chose those deliverables
  • Professional communication and presentation skills (both internal and external) while showcasing strong problem solving ability.
  • Build daily fluency with Claude and nova tools to accelerate execution — increasingly the default way work gets done, not an occasional shortcut

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Prepaid Medicine Plan
  • 15 paid vacation days (PTO) per year
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time 400.000 COP Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 17 observed Colombian national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Legal benefits like Prima, Cesantias
  • Paid Social Security
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Position Description & Requirements

POSITION HIGHLIGHTS
