  • Weekend shifts:7a–2p or 2p–9p CST
Position Summary

Medical X-Ray Consultants (MXC), a Radiology Partners practice, is seeking a Part-time Remote General/Emergency Radiologist to provide evening and weekend coverage.

This role focuses on interpreting general diagnostic and emergency radiology studies across outpatient, inpatient, and emergency department settings. The position offers a flexible remote schedule and is well suited for radiologists seeking moonlighting opportunities or supplemental income alongside their primary practice.

Radiologists work within Radiology Partners’ integrated technology platform, supporting efficient workflow, collaboration, and real-time communication across the practice.

DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Osteopathy (DO), residency trained in Diagnostic Radiology
  • Board eligible or board certified by the American Board of Radiology (ABR) or American Osteopathic Board of Radiology (AOBR)
  • Wisconsin and Minnesota medical licensure, or eligibility through the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)

COMPENSATION:

  • Compensation for this role is productivity-based and paid per RVU.
  • Radiologists are compensated at a rate of $45–$50 per RVU or range is $80,000-$196,000, depending on experience and scheduling structure.
  • Actual earnings will vary based on individual productivity and number of shifts worked.
  • This position is structured as an independent contractor (1099) role.

For More information or to apply:

For inquiries about this position, please contact Annie Lewis .

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW:

Medical X-Ray Consultants (MXC), a Radiology Partners practice, is a well-established radiology group serving hospitals and healthcare systems across Northwest Wisconsin and Eastern Minnesota. The practice provides comprehensive diagnostic imaging services along with select interventional procedures across a diverse mix of community and rural hospitals.

MXC is supported by a team of board-certified, fellowship-trained radiologists with subspecialty expertise in neuroradiology, musculoskeletal imaging, body imaging, interventional radiology, nuclear medicine, and women’s imaging. The group delivers 24/7 imaging services across multiple modalities including MRI, CT, ultrasound, nuclear medicine, PET-CT, and general radiography.

As part of Radiology Partners, MXC combines local physician leadership with national technology infrastructure, supporting efficient workflow, collaboration, and high-quality patient care across the region.

RADIOLOGY PARTNERS OVERVIEW

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer.RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. We hold that diversity is a key source of strength from which we will build a practice culture that is inclusive for all. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

jobs.title: (Senior) Data Scientist - Operations (m/f/n)
jobs.excerpt: Your work will include: • Designing routing and allocation algorithms for parcel delivery • Solving large-scale optimization problems (vehicles, routes, constraints, costs) • Applying graph-based methods, clustering, regression and forecasting • Building models that directly impact delivery speed, cost efficiency and customer experience • Shipping solutions into production - not just experiments What we’re looking for: We don’t expect you to tick every box - but you should feel comfortable with complex problem-solving and working with messy real-world systems.
jobs.description:
Your work will include:

  • Designing routing and allocation algorithms for parcel delivery
  • Solving large-scale optimization problems (vehicles, routes, constraints, costs)
  • Applying graph-based methods, clustering, regression and forecasting
  • Building models that directly impact delivery speed, cost efficiency and customer experience
  • Shipping solutions into production - not just experiments

What we’re looking for:

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but you should feel comfortable with complex problem-solving and working with messy real-world systems.

Must have:

  • ~3+ years in Data Science / ML roles
  • Strong Python skills and experience with data/ML libraries
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets
  • Solid understanding of ML methods (regression, clustering, forecasting, etc.)
  • Ability to translate business problems into data solutions

You’ll stand out if you:

  • Have worked on optimization problems (routing, scheduling, operations research)
  • Know graph-based approaches or network problems
  • Have built models that are used in production at scale
  • Have experience with PySpark / cloud (Databricks, GCP, AWS, Snowflake)
  • Have experience with ML Ops / CI/CD pipelines
  • Are familiar with optimization techniques (linear programming, heuristics)
  • Are familiar with Kedro or similar frameworks

Why join InPost?

  • Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
  • You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership team, expanding your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industries.
  • InPost is a growing company that offers its people an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
  • Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits and investing in providing training opportunities for people development.
  • You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and the circular economy every day.
  • Excellent working environment and flexible hours
  • We offer B2B type of contract

InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading OOH e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska, InPost provides delivery services through our network of almost 47,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and almost 35,000 pick-up drop-off points (PUDO) in nine countries across Europe, as well as to-door courier and fulfilment services to e-commerce merchants. InPost’s lockers provide consumers with a cheaper and more flexible, convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless delivery option.

You’ll join our Operations Data Science Team, solving some of the most complex and impactful logistics problems at scale. Your models won’t sit in notebooks - they will move millions of parcels every day!

Tech stack: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, PyTorch / TensorFlow), PySpark & distributed processing, Cloud platforms (Azure / GCP / AWS). Databricks, SQL & data warehouses

jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is a Clinical Research Organization. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.

Due to continued growth we are currently seeking a Project Support Specialist. The Project Support Specialist will serve as a member of the project team providing cross-functional support with the goal of contributing toward efficient management of the studies to which they are assigned.

This position can be offered fully home based in the following locations - Poland, Serbia, Slovakia, Hungary or Romania.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Creates and maintains the project timeline in MS Project or similar system. Ensures updates are captured and documented. Ensures the distribution of updates to study team members.
  • Schedules internal and external meetings, assists with preparing and circulating agendas, takes meeting minutes, circulates meeting minutes, and files meeting agendas and minutes in the Trial Master File.
  • Performs an array of activities in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) including maintaining study milestone dates, updating study contact lists, maintaining enrolment projections as needed, and submitting helpdesk tickets and ensuring remediation is completed.
  • Prepares, assigns, and documents study-specific training in appropriate systems; manages and oversees the maintenance of training records. Identifies gaps in training and engages appropriate team members or escalates as needed.
  • Establishes a study-level Share Point site or similar shared working space and ensures appropriate access to study team, sponsors and others as appropriate.
  • Creates project-specific email boxes and maintains appropriate access to study team members.
  • Manages user access to study systems by submitting user requests to the Help Desk or similar, by reviewing team member access on a define periodic basis, and document access review.
  • Orders study supplies and addresses queries on study supplies.
  • Orders initial study binders. Collects, collates and prepares study binders and ensures shipping to the proper locations through printing vendor.
  • Maintains various study trackers as needed and directed by the Project Manager, Clinical Trial Manager or other project leader.
  • Sends communications to study sites, investigators and others, as directed by the Project Manager, Clinical Trial Manager or other Project Leadership, including SUSARs, email blasts, newsletters and other information that may be required.
  • May support the distribution and tracking of IND Safety Reports/SUSARS/CIOMS according to the procedures defined by the study team in the project plan, as applicable, may be under Safety staff guidance.
  • May support the translation process of site level documents, as applicable, per local and regional standards.
  • May act as point of contact for project-related requests for team members, Sponsors, and third party vendors.
  • Supports the preparation, distribution, and the reconciliation of study material during applicable phases of the study (Operations Manual, ISF, patient cards, etc.) as applicable.
  • May support team leaders with the production of various study reports and updates (e.g., country/site initiation, activation, recruitment).
  • Performs other duties as assigned by the Project Manager, Clinical Trial Manager or other Project Leadership.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • 4-year college degree, or equivalent experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience as a Clinical Trial Assistant, Clinical Support Specialist or similar position.

Other Required:

  • Fluency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
  • Customer service demeanour; demonstrate flexibility, teamwork, and a keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing at the English proficiently (Professional level). Competencies:
  • Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, Precision SOPs, and regulatory guidance.
  • Demonstrates solid interpersonal skills.
  • Exhibits strong self-motivation, is detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Commitment to performing professionally consistent with Precision Principles.

Precision medicine is revolutionizing the attack on cancer—and we are passionate about helping you harness its power. We strike tumours on a molecular level using biomarkers to link specific mutations to specific treatments. We combine deep science with deep data from advanced technological platforms, then layer on specialized expertise in the design and execution of targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Ultimately, we deliver robust insights that inform real-time decisions—and optimize the oncology development pathway.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Job Title

Business Analyst - Data Analytics

Job Description Summary

Hands-on business and delivery analyst who turns business needs into practical data integration solutions, high-quality deliverables, and measurable operational results.

Job Description

The Business Analyst - Data Analytics role is an exciting opportunity for a versatile technology professional who enjoys solving business problems, working with stakeholders, and turning data and integration needs into practical solutions. This role is ideal for someone with experience in technology requirements, data integration, solution design, and implementation within a matrixed, global business environment. Commercial real estate experience is preferred.

The candidate will play an active role in shaping and delivering technology solutions that support business transformation and advance the Company’s growth initiatives.

As a key member of the Operations division, this role blends execution with cross-functional collaboration to deliver data, technology, and strategic business solutions that streamline how teams work.

This position offers the opportunity to make a visible impact on business performance and client experience. The successful candidate will be curious, proactive, and comfortable rolling up their sleeves across multiple stages of the project lifecycle.

Core Responsibilities

Business & Technology Analysis

  • Partner with Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Purchasing teams to understand day-to-day challenges and build practical solutions that streamline workflows.
  • Lead current-state, future-state, gap, requirements, and business process analysis for integration-related initiatives.
  • Work directly with data to support analysis, validation, mapping, migration, and issue resolution activities.
  • Support enterprise digital strategy initiatives by helping teams adopt better tools, processes, and ways of working.
  • Review existing business processes, identify opportunities to reduce friction, and support practical enhancements where appropriate.
  • Stay close to emerging trends in data analytics, data strategy, automation, and cloud-based data operations to bring fresh ideas to the business.
  • Champion technology and analytics as a value-added capability by showing how connected data can support business goals, solve pain points, and strengthen decision-making.
  • Develop a strong working knowledge of data-related products and connect technical capabilities to clear business value for clients and internal partners.
  • Identify innovative data and integration opportunities that can strengthen business strategies and drive better operational outcomes.
  • Build trusted relationships with decision makers, business users, and technology stakeholders through consistent communication and reliable delivery.
  • Support business case development by helping define the opportunity, expected value, practical approach, and delivery considerations.

Delivery

  • Drive delivery activities from discovery and planning through execution and adoption.
  • Coordinate and facilitate working sessions, workshops, stakeholder meetings, and vendor discussions to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Gather, document, validate, and refine business and technical requirements through direct engagement with users.
  • Help move technical solutions from concept to delivery by coordinating tasks, resolving blockers, and supporting implementation activities.
  • Lead selected initiatives with a bias for action, accountability, and practical problem solving.
  • Define, document, and support test case execution to confirm solutions work as intended.
  • Partner with project delivery teams to turn approved work into successful outcomes that are adopted and sustained.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 3-5 years of practical experience with business or technology analysis platforms, with technologies such as MS SharePoint, MS Power Automate, MS Power Apps, MS Dataverse, MS Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Looker Studio, Apps Script, Triana or equivalent platforms; data migration; API management; cloud integration technologies; and CMMS systems.
  • 3-5 years of experience in commercial real estate, or equivalent experience within a technology function supporting complex business operations.
  • Proven ability to connect business operations, technology needs, and delivery execution while staying engaged in the details needed to get work done.

Skills & Personal Qualities

  • Execution-oriented professional who enjoys solving problems and moving work from idea to implementation.
  • Curious, eager to learn, and motivated to expand their impact in a collaborative environment.
  • Comfortable leading initiatives while also rolling up their sleeves as an active team member.
  • Emotionally intelligent, inclusive, and receptive to diverse perspectives and experiences.
  • Adaptable, flexible, and open to new ways of working.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguity, making progress with limited information, and delivering under tight timelines.
  • Able to quickly understand complex business processes and convert them into clear technical activities, requirements, and action plans.
  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with a personable and professional approach.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to connect the big picture to practical milestones and next steps.

Role Summary

Pfizer is a global leader in biopharmaceutical innovation, committed to breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. The Integrated Medicine ABM leads a high-performing team across both the Neuroscience (Migraine) and Cardiovascular (NVAF/VTE) portfolios — two of Pfizer’s most strategically important therapeutic areas.

This role requires a manager who can operate across complex, science-intensive customer environments, develop deep clinical credibility with specialists and primary care stakeholders, and drive commercial performance across a broad portfolio. The ABM reports to the Regional Business Director and works closely with Marketing, Channel, and cross-functional HQ partners to deliver on business imperatives.

Role Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Hire, coach, develop, and manage 9–12 representatives across Neuroscience and Cardiovascular portfolios

  • Establish clear team goals, hold team members accountable to performance standards, and manage underperformance with directness and care

  • Build a strong team culture grounded in engagement, morale, and a continuous improvement mindset

  • Apply situational leadership and multimodal coaching — live, virtual, and hybrid — to strengthen rep capabilities across all engagement types

  • Ensure colleagues receive meaningful development opportunities that support career growth and long-term engagement

Business Planning & Execution

  • Develop and implement strategic area business plans aligned to national and regional priorities across both therapeutic areas

  • Own area-level budget accountability; plans, organizes, and monitors resource deployment to maximize business potential

  • Conduct proactive data analysis to identify market trends, assess key stakeholders, and anticipate future shifts in the business landscape

  • Ensure effective and efficient utilization of promotional materials and measure field execution against plan

  • Collaborate with Marketing during the Op Plan process to shape key strategies, business imperatives, and objectives

Customer Engagement & Key Account Development

  • Build and maintain relationships with customers (including KOLs), large group practices, hospitals, and managed care organizations across both the Migraine and NVAF/VTE landscapes

  • Model high clinical knowledge and the ability to lead credible, science-forward conversations across therapeutic areas

  • Identify and pursue key account development opportunities that impact area and national business

  • Champion the value of cross-functional collaboration to meet customer needs; connect HSPs with channel and HQ partners to address complex customer requirements

  • Coach reps on seamlessly integrating digital tools and cross-functional colleagues into customer engagements

Compliance & Integrity

  • Ensure full compliance of all selling activities for self and team with all legal, regulatory, and Pfizer policy requirements

  • Maintain complete working knowledge of all relevant compliance policies; escalate issues promptly

  • Ensure all team actions reflect Pfizer’s commitment to integrity, model compliant behavior in every customer and internal interaction

Digital & Operational Excellence

  • Expert-level operation of digital and virtual tools and platforms

  • Apply data-driven resource management to ensure appropriate channel deployment across a dual-portfolio area

  • Leverage sales data and reporting software to draw conclusions, adjust strategy, and adapt to Pfizer’s evolving technology model

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required

  • 6+ years of pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical marketing/sales experience, with at least 3–5 years in a demonstrated leadership role across peer and customer groups

  • Experience engaging key thought leaders or high-influence customers in large group practices, hospitals, or managed care organizations preferred

  • Valid U.S. driver’s license with driving record in compliance with company standards; any DUI/DWI or impaired driving citation within the past 7 years is disqualifying

  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities including the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, and create meaningful business impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or relevant graduate degree preferred

  • 5+ years of people management experience; proven ability to develop and motivate others, lead through change, and deliver on business imperatives

  • Specialty sales experience and therapeutic expertise strongly preferred; cross-portfolio or integrated medicine experience a plus

  • Ability to develop and reinforce team expertise across a broader portfolio with a “Science First” mindset

  • Cross-functional collaboration mindset aligned to a “One Pfizer” commitment to the customer

  • Feedback-driven culture builder; proactively identifies areas of improvement with accountability to Rep 2.0 standards

  • Model for change, agility, and adaptability in a dynamic commercial environment

  • Advanced virtual communication skills for customer engagement, team management, and remote collaboration

  • Strong organizational and analytical skills; ability to interpret sales data, reporting applications, and adapt to evolving technology platforms

  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and execute with precision to deliver results

  • Strong track record of collaborative, motivational leadership and internal stakeholder management

  • Enterprise thinking with the ability to anticipate downstream consequences

  • Excellent facilitation skills

Travel & Work Schedule

  • Field travel required; overnight travel expected based on area geography and business need

  • Ability to travel across all representative territories within the area

  • Attendance at area and national meetings required

Other Job Details

VP/Field CTO, GTM - Telecommunications

About the Role

As a Field CTO – Telecommunications, you will be the architect of NewRocket's growth strategy in the telco sector — shaping how we go to market, what we offer, and how we win. You will define and build industry-specific offerings grounded in the real business process challenges facing telecommunications operators, and partner with Product Marketing to translate those offerings into pipeline-generating programs that elevate NewRocket's presence in the industry.

This is a strategic, senior, client-facing role that combines industry thought leadership, offering development, and executive-level client engagement. You will be the person who ensures NewRocket has a compelling, differentiated point of view in telecommunications — spanning AI-powered industry solutions and targeted data offerings — and that it consistently drives top-of-funnel activity and competitive wins.

What You'll Do

Shape the Telco Go-to-Market

  • Define NewRocket's offering strategy for the telecommunications industry, identifying the highest-value business process problems where NewRocket can deliver differentiated outcomes.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop industry-specific messaging, positioning, and content — including thought leadership, solution briefs, campaign assets, and event presence — that generates awareness and top-of-funnel pipeline.
  • Represent NewRocket's telco point of view externally through speaking engagements, industry forums (TM Forum, GSMA), white papers, and executive roundtables.
  • Monitor industry trends — BSS/OSS modernization, 5G monetization, AI-driven network operations, agentic AI, cloud-native transformation — and translate them into timely, relevant go-to-market narratives.

Architect AI Industry Solutions

  • Design and architect AI-powered solutions purpose-built for the telecommunications industry — including agentic AI workflows, predictive operations, intelligent process automation, and AI-assisted customer and network management.
  • Define how AI capabilities map to specific telco business processes — for example, AI-driven fault prediction and resolution in network operations, intelligent order fallout management in service fulfillment, dynamic resource reassignment in field operations.
  • Develop AI solutions that are aligned with ServiceNow’s broad capability areas, that integrate with existing BSS/OSS and network environments, clearly defining data inputs, model requirements, workflow orchestration, and business outcome metrics.
  • Stay current on the evolving AI and agentic landscape — including large language models, AI agents, and multi-model orchestration — and translate these into credible, practical applications for telco clients.
  • Work with NewRocket's internal AI capabilities (including the Intelligent Agent Crew and NewRocket Intelligence) to apply and extend proprietary assets in telco-specific contexts.

Define Targeted Data Offerings

  • Identify and design data offerings specific to the telecommunications industry — addressing the data challenges, gaps, and opportunities that sit behind every major telco transformation initiative.
  • Define telco-specific data products and frameworks across key domains:
    • Network data: topology, performance KPIs/KQIs, CDRs/xDRs, alarm and event streams, and network inventory datasets.
    • Customer & product data: subscriber profiles, product catalog structures, service configurations, and entitlement data.
    • Operational data: trouble ticket histories, SLA breach records, workforce management data, and field service records.
  • Architect data integration and management frameworks — including data strategies and data quality approaches — that enable AI, analytics, and operational intelligence use cases.
  • Partner with clients to define data strategies that turn underutilized telco data assets into measurable business value.

Build Industry-Specific Offerings

  • Design and develop telco-specific offerings tied to core telecommunications business processes, including order management, service fulfillment, network assurance, trouble-to-resolve, revenue assurance, and fraud management — as well as AI-powered and data-driven extensions of these processes.
  • Define offering frameworks that span business process design, solution architecture, AI integration, data strategy, platform configuration, and delivery — ensuring each offering is grounded in operational reality and executable by delivery teams.
  • Build reusable solution assets — reference architectures, process blueprints, industry data models, and configuration accelerators — that give NewRocket a repeatable, scalable edge across the telco market.
  • Collaborate with delivery, product, and engineering teams to validate offering feasibility and ensure they can be brought to market with confidence.

Lead Executive Client Engagement

  • Engage directly with C-level, VP, and senior executive stakeholders at telco clients and prospects — leading strategic conversations that connect business outcomes to solution architecture.
  • Facilitate executive workshops and architecture reviews that surface the right business priorities, define success criteria, and establish NewRocket as a trusted strategic partner.
  • Translate complex telco business challenges — spanning customer, service, network, infrastructure, and financial domains — into clear architectural recommendations that drive measurable outcomes.

Support Pre-Sales

  • Provide senior architectural guidance on active telco pursuits, shaping solution scope, investment cases, and win strategy in collaboration with sales teams.
  • Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and solution narratives that articulate the business value of NewRocket's telco offerings to senior buyer audiences.
  • Contribute to RFP and RFI responses, ensuring proposed solutions are architecturally sound, differentiated, and aligned to the client's strategic direction.

What You Bring

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in solutions architecture, strategy consulting, or technology leadership with direct experience serving or working within the telecommunications industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of developing go-to-market offerings, solution frameworks, or industry practices — not just delivering projects.
  • Experience engaging at the C-suite and VP level, driving strategic technology conversations that result in business commitment.

Telco Domain Expertise

  • Deep, practitioner-level knowledge of core telco business processes across 2 of the 3 major areas of the value chain:
    • Customer: Lead-to-cash, order management, CPQ, customer care, and churn management.
    • Service & Network: Service fulfillment, activate-to-bill, trouble-to-resolve, fault management, and SLA assurance.
    • Infrastructure: Plan-to-build, network provisioning, capacity management, and asset lifecycle.
  • Ability to connect business process design to the supporting technology and data environments that make transformation real and sustainable.

Technology & Architecture

  • Strong architectural fluency across BSS/OSS platforms (Amdocs, Ericsson, Oracle Communications, Netcracker, Salesforce Industries), integration patterns, AI/ML architecture, and cloud-native telco architectures.
  • Experience architecting AI and agentic solutions — including LLM-based workflows, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and multi-agent orchestration — within enterprise technology environments.
  • Proficiency with TM Forum frameworks — eTOM, TAM, and Open APIs — as tools for offering design, scoping, and executive communication.

Reporting To

Chief Growth & Alliances Officer (CGAO)

About NewRocket

NewRocket is the AI-first Elite ServiceNow partner that activates real value on the platform. We combine industry expertise, human-centered design, and enterprise-grade AI to help organizations navigate change and scale with confidence. With nearly two decades of ServiceNow experience and thousands of successful implementations, NewRocket goes beyond workflows to build better workplaces where employees flourish and customers thrive.

Client Service Coordinator
The person who keeps client communication, documents, and next steps moving.
Position: Full-time, non-exempt, 40 hours per weekWork location: Remote with optional in-office access for Seattle-area employeesTeam: Tax Department AdministrationSalary: $58,000-68,000 depending upon experience

About R.D. Barnett PLLC

R.D. Barnett PLLC is a growing accounting, tax, and advisory firm. Accounting, tax, and advisory services are the heart of our business, but relationships are our lifeblood. We listen, ask questions, customize solutions, and care about outcomes. We are also a technology-forward firm that uses modern systems, automation, and AI tools to improve the client and employee experience.

Position Overview

The Client Service Coordinator is the traffic controller for the client journey. This person coordinates communication, documents, deadlines, and handoffs between clients and our professionals so clients always know what is needed, what happens next, and who is responsible. The role owns the daily execution of nontechnical client-service workflows across tax, accounting, and advisory engagements.

Important role boundary: This position does not answer tax-specific questions or make technical tax determinations. No prior tax knowledge is required. The coordinator gathers facts, provides administrative guidance, and routes technical questions to the appropriate professional.

What You Will Own

Client Communication and Triage

  • Serve as a responsive, welcoming point of contact for client and prospect questions related to systems, document receipt, & general process questions.
  • Monitor assigned shared inboxes, client portals, and incoming requests; acknowledge receipt, clarify what is needed, and route each item to the right person.
  • Help clients use firm-supported systems, portals, document uploads, access codes, and electronic signatures.
  • Conduct scripted introductory calls with prospective clients, gather nontechnical background information, explain the firm's process, and coordinate next steps for scoping. Provide support to the Business Development efforts with follow up on proposals, scoping documents, and proposal generation.
  • Communicate proactively when an answer or deliverable is still in progress so clients are never left wondering whether their request was received.

Onboarding, Offboarding, and Engagement Administration

  • Coordinate onboarding for new, re-engaging, and established clients, including client records, contacts, access, permissions, project setup, and internal handoffs.
  • Draft and coordinate engagement letters, proposals, and related client agreements using approved scopes and pricing; track completion and escalate stalled items.
  • Coordinate required offshore-consent documentation and maintain accurate completion records.
  • Manage client offboarding and disengagement workflows, including records, access, communication steps, and internal notifications.

Tax-Season Client Coordination

  • Prepare and send organizers, questionnaires, document requests, and reminders through the firm's approved systems.
  • Review, file, and organize client-uploaded information; identify incomplete submissions, acknowledge receipt, notify the appropriate team, and update the related project or tracker.
  • Create and maintain client binders and other administrative workpapers in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Follow up on missing information, signatures, engagement letters, organizer completion, and other open items needed to move client work forward.
  • Coordinate tax-return delivery, electronic signature, e-file authorization, filing, and final document distribution; monitor status across systems and escalate risks before deadlines are affected.
  • Provide administrative support for client payment and tax-agency processes as directed, without interpreting tax law or providing tax advice.

Project & Workflow Coordination

  • Own the administrative movement of client work through the firm’s workflow systems, including promptly marking materials as received, initiating the appropriate projects and workflows, and keeping work moving through each required stage.
  • Monitor project status, deadlines, outstanding information, and next steps; follow up on stalled or overdue items and escalate blockers to the appropriate team member.
  • Manage tasks within Double, including creating, assigning, updating, monitoring, and closing tasks as the platform is implemented across the firm.
  • Maintain accurate project records so team members can quickly identify each project’s current status, responsible party, outstanding needs, and next action.

Client Records, Notion, and Workflow Visibility

  • Own the day-to-day accuracy and upkeep of tax-department client pages and administrative trackers in Notion.
  • Keep client contacts, services, project status, meeting notes, key context, open requests, and next actions current across approved systems.
  • Run routine client-service and tax-administration reports, reconcile discrepancies, and follow up on items that are incomplete or overdue.
  • Document repeatable procedures and maintain usable checklists so work is consistent, transferable, and easy to train.

Relationship Support

  • Maintain a relationship-outreach calendar for birthday messages, milestone acknowledgements, approved client gifts, and other high-touch follow-up.
  • Coordinate approved client communications through Mailchimp or similar tools and keep outreach records current.
  • During lighter periods, prioritize client-record cleanup, proactive outreach, onboarding and offboarding maintenance, process documentation, and other client-service work that improves readiness for the next deadline cycle.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients receive prompt acknowledgement, clear next steps, and professional follow-through.
  • Engagement letters, organizers, document requests, signatures, and delivery steps are completed on time or escalated early.
  • Client pages, trackers, and system records are accurate enough for the team to rely on without detective work.
  • Technical professionals spend less time on administrative follow-up and have the information they need when they need it.
  • Client-service procedures are documented, repeatable, and consistently followed.
  • The firm enters peak periods organized and exits them with records and outstanding items under control.
  • You adapt quickly as the firm grows and systems, processes, and responsibilities evolve, learning new tools and translating change into consistent client-service execution.

Who You Are

  • Service-minded. You make people feel heard, respond promptly, and communicate clearly even when the full answer is not yet available.
  • Detail-oriented. You document decisions, maintain accurate records, and notice missing information before it becomes a deadline problem.
  • Accountable. You own follow-through, use reliable tracking systems, and escalate risks instead of hoping they disappear.
  • Communicative. You are comfortable emailing and calling clients and can translate process steps into plain language.
  • Proactive. You anticipate follow-ups, spot bottlenecks, and act before someone has to chase you.
  • Trustworthy. You handle confidential client and firm information with sound judgment and discretion.
  • Technology-comfortable. You learn new systems quickly and use tools, templates, automation, and AI responsibly to improve your work.
  • Adaptable. You remain calm and organized in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • Process-minded. You improve and document repeatable work.
  • Self-directed. You manage priorities, follow established processes, and move work forward with minimal supervision, while using sound judgment to ask questions or escalate issues when needed.

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of experience in client service, administration, project coordination, or a related role.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including confidence speaking directly with clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines, follow-ups, systems, and stakeholders without losing visibility.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel, plus the ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly.
  • Experience with Notion, Missive, SafeSend, Practice CS, QuickBooks Online, tax workflow software, or other professional-services systems is helpful butnot required.
  • Experience in an accounting, legal, financial-services, or other deadline-driven professional-services environment is preferred but not required.
  • Ability to work additional hours as needed during peak periods, typically February through April 15 and September through October 15, with the heaviest demands near filing deadlines.

What This Role Is Not

  • It is not responsible for providing tax advice, answering technical tax questions, or making accounting or tax judgments.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Full time, non-exempt position with a salary of $58,000-68,000 depending upon experience
  • Seattle-area employees may work in-office or on a hybrid schedule. Employees located outside the Seattle area may work fully remote, subject to firm approval and applicable state employment requirements.

  • 15 vacation days per year.
  • Two paid volunteer days each year.
  • Three percent 401(k) retirement match.
  • 100% company-paid premium for Medical (BCBS PPO), vision, and dental (Delta Dental PPO) benefits.

Growth Opportunity

R.D. Barnett PLLC is growing, and what is needed today may be different from what is needed tomorrow. This description is not intended to list every possible activity, duty, or responsibility. Team members who demonstrate strong client judgment, reliable execution, and leadership will have opportunities to expand their responsibilities and grow with the firm.

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $50/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

About the Position:

The Director of Account Management leads ChowNow's post-sale revenue engine — owning renewal and retention across our restaurant base, partnering with Sales to drive expansion through cross-sell and upsell, and reactivating churned customers through a structured winback motion. You'll be accountable for the activation and adoption of new products as ChowNow's suite continues to grow, ensuring customers realize value quickly and the revenue follows.

This is a transformational role. ChowNow is in an exciting phase of new product launches and an evolving go-to-market motion, and we're looking for a leader who can act as a change agent — building the playbooks, team structure, and operating cadence needed to scale a modern Account Management function. You'll bring the strategic vision to set the direction, the operational rigor to execute against it, and the leadership presence to bring the team and cross-functional partners along with you.

You put restaurants first. You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.
You celebrate diversity. You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are. You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.
You raise your hand. You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.
You keep reaching. You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Leading and developing a team of managers and individual contributors, building the coaching, capability, and structure needed to scale Account Management as ChowNow grows.

  • Building and operationalizing the renewal motion for annual contracts (proactive outreach, negotiation, uplift) and the retention motion for monthly customers (engagement, adoption, downgrade prevention).

  • Designing and deploying cross-sell and upsell plays mapped to ChowNow's product suite — including qualification criteria, talk tracks, and rep enablement to support expansion opportunities consistently.

  • Building and maintaining an account health framework that flags at-risk customers early, triggers consistent save motions, and reduces churn across both annual and monthly populations.

  • Driving measurable lifts in product adoption and value realization in partnership with Marketing, Product, and Lifecycle teams.

  • Running a weekly forecast cadence covering renewals, churn risk, and expansion pipeline; deliver against forecast with the discipline and accuracy leadership can rely on.

  • Surfacing the top systemic drivers of churn and downgrade to the executive team, with a prioritized cross-functional remediation roadmap spanning Product, Onboarding, Pricing, and Support.

  • Partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Billing to align on customer lifecycle ownership, expansion handoffs, and retention strategy.

  • Delivering a comprehensive Account Management strategy — covering NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, and adoption — with quarterly targets and the operating plan to hit them.

  • Proven ownership of NRR and GRR in a SaaS or subscription business, with direct accountability for both assisting with expansion (cross-sell/upsell) and churn reduction.

  • A track record of building account health scoring, early warning systems, and save playbooks that produced measurable churn reduction.

  • Strong forecasting discipline; you can build a renewal and expansion forecast leadership can plan against and deliver against it consistently.

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce, a CS or AM platform (Gainsight, Catalyst, ChurnZero, or similar), Google Workspace, and MS Office.

Job Description Summary

‎

Position Summary
The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted strategic advisor and operational partner to the Chief Executive Officer (or Vice President, Strategy), helping maximize executive effectiveness while accelerating execution of Mosaic Health’s highest-priority strategic initiatives.
This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving enterprise coordination, executive operating cadence, strategic execution, transformation initiatives, and executive communications across the organization. Acting as an extension of executive leadership, the Chief of Staff ensures priorities are translated into action, cross-functional teams remain aligned, and critical initiatives are executed with discipline and urgency.
The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, private equity-backed environment and possess the judgment, business acumen, and influence required to work effectively across executive leadership, Board members, business unit leaders, and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, solving complex operational challenges, and driving flawless execution.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

What You’ll Do

Executive Office Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and operational extension of the CEO (or VP, Strategy), ensuring executive focus remains on the organization’s highest-value priorities.
  • Manage executive priorities by coordinating decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely execution of follow-up actions.
  • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively resolve issues before they require executive intervention.
  • Prepare the CEO for Board meetings, sponsor interactions, customer meetings, investor discussions, and other strategic engagements.
  • Continuously improve executive workflows by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to increase productivity.

Executive Leadership Team Effectiveness

  • Own and continuously improve the Executive Leadership Team’s operating cadence.
  • Develop executive meeting agendas, pre-read materials, action logs, decision trackers, and governance processes.
  • Ensure accountability for enterprise commitments through disciplined follow-up and progress tracking.
  • Connect priorities across business units and corporate functions to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration across the executive team while promoting transparency, alignment, and shared accountability.

Strategy Execution & Enterprise Initiatives

  • Translate executive priorities into actionable workplans with defined milestones, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple business units or lack a natural organizational owner.
  • Partner with senior leaders to remove execution barriers and accelerate enterprise priorities.
  • Develop executive dashboards and progress reports that provide visibility into strategic initiatives and organizational performance.
  • Support annual strategic planning and enterprise prioritization activities.

Enterprise Transformation

  • Coordinate enterprise transformation initiatives in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Maintain executive project plans, governance documentation, milestone tracking, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Support organizational redesign, business integration, and enterprise change management initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation efforts remain aligned with Mosaic Health’s strategic objectives and value creation plan.

Executive Communications & Board Support

  • Develop polished executive presentations, Board materials, sponsor updates, and strategic communications.
  • Improve the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive messaging across internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate responses to Board members, investors, and private equity sponsors.
  • Ensure executives are equipped with high-quality materials that enable informed decision-making and effective stakeholder engagement.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, and functional teams across Mosaic Health.
  • Influence without formal authority through credibility, collaboration, and exceptional follow-through.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a connector across the organization, helping leaders navigate complex issues and align around shared priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Eight or more years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, private equity, corporate development, investment banking, healthcare operations, or a Chief of Staff role supporting senior executives.
  • Experience working directly with a CEO or executive leadership team in a complex, high-growth organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation development.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve business processes and executive productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare services, value-based care, managed care, provider organizations, or healthcare technology.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed organization.
  • Familiarity with Board governance, investor communications, and sponsor reporting.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, organizational integration, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Strong enterprise and commercial acumen.
  • Executive presence and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority.
  • Outstanding organizational discipline and follow-through.
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Resourcefulness, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.
  • High humility, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for simplifying complexity.

Success in the Role

Within the first 12 months, the successful Chief of Staff will:

  • Significantly increase executive leadership effectiveness through disciplined operating cadence and organizational alignment.
  • Improve CEO leverage by assuming responsibility for high-impact strategic and operational work.
  • Deliver Board materials, executive presentations, and strategic communications that consistently require minimal executive revision.
  • Successfully coordinate enterprise strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Strengthen accountability across executive workstreams through transparent governance and follow-through.
  • Improve cross-functional collaboration and visibility into enterprise priorities.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows that enhance executive productivity and organizational efficiency.
  • Become a trusted advisor to executive leadership, Board members, and private equity sponsors through thoughtful judgment, credibility, and flawless execution.

Mosaic Health is committed to building an inclusive workplace where talented individuals from diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe better care begins with empowered people, collaborative teams, and leaders who are passionate about improving the health of the communities we serve.

If you’re energized by solving complex problems, influencing enterprise-wide strategy, and helping shape the future of healthcare delivery, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.excerpt: Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare.
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

Datavant is building the infrastructure that makes health information more connected, useful, and accessible when it matters most. In our Legal & Insurance vertical, that means helping attorneys, copy services, insurers, and other requesters retrieve the right medical records faster, understand what is inside them, and move high-stakes decisions forward with confidence.

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to define and lead the product strategy for Datavant’s Legal & Insurance vertical. This is an individual contributor role who can operate at multiple altitudes: setting long-term vision, shaping product architecture, influencing executive investment decisions, and still diving deep into workflows, data, AI, operations, and customer pain.

This vertical is early, strategically important, and full of hard product problems. Medical record retrieval for legal and insurance use cases are complex, fragmented, and time-sensitive. Requesters need transparency, reliability, speed, completeness, and increasingly, intelligent tools that help them understand large volumes of clinical information. Providers and partners need scalable, compliant workflows. Datavant has the opportunity to bring these pieces together into a more connected, modern product experience.

In this role, you will define what the Legal & Insurance product suite becomes. You’ll work across engineering, data science, operations, design, commercial teams, and executive leadership to build the vertical from the ground up. You’ll shape the underlying workflows, data models, integrations, platform logic, and AI-enabled experiences that power record retrieval and downstream analysis. You’ll make strategic tradeoffs, bring clarity to ambiguity, and create durable product systems that can scale across customer segments and use cases.

This is a rare opportunity for a Staff PM to build a new business line inside a company with deep healthcare data infrastructure, real customer demand, and meaningful room for product innovation. The right person will be energized by complex systems, high-stakes user needs, and the chance to build at the intersection of healthcare, law, insurance, data, and AI.

What You Will Do

  • Define the long-term product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for Datavant’s Legal & Insurance vertical.
  • Translate a complex, fragmented market into a coherent product strategy across requester experience, retrieval workflows, fulfillment, integrations, and record analysis.
  • Shape the product architecture for a new vertical, including workflows, data models, platform capabilities, partner integrations, and AI-enabled experiences.
  • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate opportunities, set priorities, guide investment decisions, and align the organization around the highest-impact work.
  • Build scalable products for attorneys, copy services, insurers, and other requesters across both enterprise and small/mid-sized customer segments.
  • Work deeply with engineering, data science, analytics, operations, design, and commercial teams to move from strategy to execution.
  • Identify where operational friction should become product capability, and where custom workflows should become scalable platform patterns.
  • Develop AI-powered tools that help users extract, summarize, structure, and act on insights from complex medical records.
  • Establish the metrics, feedback loops, and operating rhythms needed to improve retrieval speed, completeness, transparency, quality, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
  • Serve as a product thought leader for the vertical and a mentor to other PMs, raising the bar for product strategy, systems thinking, customer insight, and execution.

What You Need to Succeed

  • 8–12+ years of product management experience, with a track record of leading complex, enterprise-grade, data-centric products.
  • Demonstrated ability to define product strategy in ambiguous spaces and influence company-level direction, not just deliver a roadmap.
  • Experience building products that combine workflow, data, integrations, operations, and user experience into scalable systems.
  • Strong systems thinking: you can understand messy, real-world workflows and turn them into simple, durable product architecture.
  • Experience working with healthcare data, data exchange, retrieval, workflow automation, platform products, or regulated data products.
  • Bonus points for experience in legal, insurance, medical record retrieval, claims, risk adjustment, clinical data, or AI-enabled document analysis.
  • Comfort designing products in highly regulated, high-stakes environments where accuracy, timeliness, compliance, privacy, and trust all matter.
  • Strong technical fluency and credibility with engineering, data science, and analytics teams.
  • Ability to use data, customer insight, and business judgment to make hard prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Executive-level communication skills: you can distill complexity, frame tradeoffs, and influence senior leaders, technical teams, operations teams, and commercial stakeholders.
  • You create clarity, raise the strategic altitude of the team, mentor others, and still roll up your sleeves to get important work across the finish line.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in ambiguity, learn quickly, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and build momentum even when the path is not obvious.
  • Collaborative, low-ego leadership style with a track record of building trust across functions and contributing to a high-performing culture.

The candidate will work on the client’s AI agents that automate operational processes in internal business operations. The main goal is to deliver measurable time savings across business functions such as finance operations, document processing, data cleaning, and other shared-service activities.

Initial use cases may include extracting and normalizing similar data from hundreds of differently structured Excel files and mapping them into a common data model for further processing, querying, or analysis.

  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and APIs
  • Implement data-quality checks, output validation, logging, error handling, and human-review steps

  • Work within the Client’s approved AI framework, security rules, and technology constraints
  • Support deployment, documentation, knowledge transfer, and initial production adoption

Requirements

  • 4+ years of commercial Python development experience
  • Practical experience building AI/LLM-powered applications or AI agents
  • Experience with prompt engineering and structured LLM outputs
  • Experience integrating LLMs via APIs or enterprise AI platforms
  • Strong experience processing data from Excel files using Python
  • Experience with pandas, openpyxl, Polars, or similar tools
  • Ability to analyze and normalize data from files with inconsistent schemas, column names, layouts, and data formats
  • Experience designing data extraction, transformation, mapping, and validation pipelines
  • Understanding of when to use deterministic rules, traditional data processing, or LLM-based interpretation
  • Experience with REST APIs and enterprise-system integrations
  • Ability to implement validation, exception handling, logging, and traceability
  • Understanding of enterprise security, access control, and sensitive-data handling
  • Ability to communicate with business users, clarify requirements, and convert operational processes into technical solutions
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate in English with international stakeholders
  • Availability for occasional on-site meetings or workshops if required

Nice to have:

  • Experience automating finance, claims, customs, logistics, documentation, or other shared-service processes
  • Experience delivering automation with measurable time or cost savings
  • Experience with multi-agent or agent-orchestration frameworks
  • Experience with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, or comparable enterprise AI platforms
  • Experience with document understanding, classification, or information-extraction solutions
  • Knowledge of RPA platforms and hybrid RPA/AI workflows
  • Experience with FastAPI, Docker, and cloud-based deployment
  • Familiarity with data-quality frameworks and master-data models
  • Experience with human-in-the-loop review and confidence-based routing
  • Experience working in a large international enterprise with controlled technology and security standards

Build estimate structures aligned to closure scopes (earthworks, demolition, water management, tailings/WRD, monitoring, revegetation, long-term care). Support closure strategy development and identify cost/risk reduction opportunities.

Mentor junior team members in estimating methods, modelling discipline, and QA practices.

This is a deeply technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable platform capabilities at scale.

Platform Engineering Mission

Platform Engineering delivers the shared application primitives, services, and guardrails that enable product engineering teams to build consistent, scalable, secure, and reliable applications across ZMP.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

jobs.description:
About The Lisinski Law Firm

Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”

About the Role

The Product Marketing & Client Experience Manager is a people-centered role that directly supports the Senior Director of Product Marketing & Client Experience. This role serves as a critical operational and strategic partner, transforming the firm's CX vision into day-to-day journey mapping, gap analysis, product marketing execution, and cross-functional coordination. This role is built around bringing to life and improving our clients’ lived experiences. Not just by mapping the internal process as designed, but the journey as our clients actually live it. The Product Marketing & CX Manager holds that perspective as the primary lens through which all work is evaluated and prioritized. This person works in close partnership with the Client Research Manager, who leads research design and execution. The Product Marketing & CX Manager translates those research outputs into actionable experience improvements, supports product marketing GTM planning & execution, and drives cross-functional alignment on the highest-impact opportunities. Success requires the ability to influence, align, and move teams without formal authority. 

Your Key Contributions

  • Lead the execution of end-to-end client journey mapping, documenting the client experience, perceptions, emotions, expectations, and mindset across every stage of engagement.
  • Validate internal process assumptions through surveys, interviews, focus groups, and other research methods involving representative client samples and audiences.
  • Translate Voice of Client data and research findings into clear storytelling materials, feedback loops, executive-ready reporting, and actionable recommendations.
  • Develop and maintain a living client insight repository that tracks trends, recurring pain points, and the measurable impact of experience improvements over time. Inputs include cNPS, social sentiment and escalations, CSC escalations, and retention escalations.
  • Translate client journey and research findings into structured gap analyses that identify where client expectations diverge from actual Firm performance. Evaluate gaps based on client impact and business significance, not frequency alone.
  • Prioritize client experience improvement opportunities using a consistent framework that weighs client impact, revenue implications, operational feasibility, and strategic alignment.
  • Develop experience design recommendations that address root causes rather than surface-level symptoms across the full client lifecycle.
  • Partner with Operations, Legal, Technology, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to develop actionable, sequenced recommendations that address the most significant client experience gaps first.
  • Support the development of SOPs and process improvements grounded in substantive, quantified client evidence rather than internal assumptions.
  • Own, track, and regularly report on the role’s CX KPIs, including cNPS trends, client sentiment on social channels, client retention rate improvements, referral rates, and resolution speed for identified pain points. Report risks, wins, journey insights, and prioritization recommendations to the Sr. Director and relevant stakeholders with equal discipline.
  • Support go-to-market planning and execution for new products and service enhancements, working in lockstep with the Sr. Director, Product Management, and Operations.
  • Develop and maintain value propositions and messaging frameworks by product line and client segment, ensuring authentic resonance with Spanish-speaking immigrant communities.
  • Contribute to GTM playbooks and execution plans covering new product launches, pricing changes, channel strategy, market expansion, launch coordination, and post-launch performance.
  • Apply a strong understanding of competitive dynamics, unmet client needs, and white-space opportunities. Contribute competitive research that informs positioning, product marketing, and service development.
  • Represent the client perspective in product development discussions by incorporating real demand signals, client needs, and usability considerations into new offerings.
  • Partner with the Client Research Manager to support Firm-wide VoC program execution, including participant coordination, data collection, cross-channel feedback management, and the translation of research into client experience and product marketing recommendations.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of client personas by case type, cultural background, and service stage.
  • Champion the client perspective across Marketing, Operations, Legal, Product Development, Business Development, CSC, and Technology. Build credibility through clarity of insight and consistency of presence, and influence cross-functional partners to prioritize client experience improvements alongside operational and financial objectives without relying on positional authority.
  • Support the integration of CX insights into the Firm’s OKR framework and quarterly planning processes.
  • As needed and under the direction of the Sr. Director, collaborate with the Client Research Manager to manage relationships with research vendors, survey platforms, and external partners.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 6-10 years of professional experience, with 3 or more years in customer experience, client journey work, legal service operations, product marketing or a closely related discipline.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • Experience working alongside or in partnership with a research function; comfortable translating research into experience and product marketing recommendations rather than owning research design independently.
  • Proven experience supporting go-to-market execution for new products or services, including GTM planning, launch coordination, and post-launch performance tracking.
  • Experience defining, tracking, and reporting on CX KPIs including cNPS, CSAT, retention, and referral metrics.
  • Decision Quality – Applies structured prioritization frameworks to evaluate CX opportunities, balancing client impact, revenue implications, operational feasibility, and strategic alignment to make sound recommendations on where the Firm should invest resources first.
  • Drives Results – Owns and reports on key CX performance metrics, leads execution of client experience improvements and product launches, and is accountable for measuring adoption, retention, referral, and client sentiment outcomes.
  • Manages Complexity – Navigates highly cross-functional work across Marketing, Operations, Legal, Technology, Product Development, and Client Services while translating diverse client insights, research findings, and business priorities into coordinated actions.
  • Optimizes Work Processes – Identifies root causes of client experience gaps, develops evidence-based process improvements and SOP recommendations, and supports integration of continuous improvement practices across the client journey.
  • Communicates Effectively – Creates executive-ready reports, translates research and Voice of Client data into compelling narratives and recommendations, and influences stakeholders through clear insights rather than formal authority.
  • Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish, with the ability to conduct research and communicate findings in both languages.
  • Deep cultural fluency with Hispanic and Latino communities, including understanding of communication norms, trust dynamics, and family decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and interpret client journey maps from the client's perspective, not just internal process documentation.
  • Strong prioritization skills; able to apply structured frameworks to evaluate competing improvement opportunities and make a clear case for sequencing.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience creating executive-ready reports and presentations.
  • Proficiency in survey tools (e.g., Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey), CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), and analytics dashboards.

Work Schedule

  • Monday through Friday, 8am-5pm Eastern Time

Compensation

The expected salary for this role is $90,000-$100,000, though the final offer will reflect several factors such as your experience, skills, and the role's location and may be outside of this range. Candidates should expect offers that reflect their individual qualifications, experience, and location. The salary provided is directional, and actual compensation may vary.

How You'll Benefit

Lisinski Law Firm provides a comprehensive benefits package that supports the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We recognize the importance of health and well-being and are committed to fostering an environment where every team member can feel and perform at their best.

  • 401k Match

  • Voluntary Life & AD&D
  • Disability Insurance
